Authors: Dantong Qin, Yike Guo, Qinlin Liu, Alessandro Bozzon, Pan Wang

Manifold-Stable Flow Matching Manipulation

flow matching contraction theory manifold invariance robotic manipulation geometric adherence

简要说明：本文提出了流形稳定流匹配（MSFM），利用收缩理论保证生成样本保持在数据流形上，从而在机器人操作实验中提高了几何一致性和任务性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces manifold-stable flow matching (MSFM), a flow matching method that uses contraction theory to guarantee generated samples stay on the data manifold, improving geometric adherence and task performance in robotic manipulation experiments.

Abstract: Flow matching (FM) learns generative dynamics through velocity regression. Geometric FM variants commonly assume a prior supported on the data manifold, requiring geometric knowledge that is often unavailable. Without such knowledge, low regression error alone does not guarantee manifold adherence. Adherence keeps generated samples within valid configurations and is empirically associated with better task performance. We introduce manifold-stable flow matching (MSFM), which can start from an arbitrary ambient prior, not necessarily supported on the manifold. Using tools from nonlinear dynamics, namely contraction theory, MSFM combines learned tangential transport with prescribed normal contraction. The construction uses analytical projectors for known manifolds and local affine proxies estimated by principal component analysis for unknown data geometry. By implementing contraction theory in both cases of known and unknown manifolds, we guarantee manifold invariance and transverse convergence to the manifold within a desired time window (e.g., one second). We derive a family of compatible probability paths and decompose the training loss into a learnable tangential term and a normal residual. An ellipse experiment attains a mean terminal off-manifold error of order $10^{-6}$. In Push-T robotic experiments, MSFM raises success from $74\%$ to $82\%$. In the Robomimic Square task, success increases from $60\%$ to $72\%$, while rotation-manifold deviation decreases from order $10^{-2}$ to $10^{-7}$. The MSFM terminal geometric errors are controlled by the chosen numerical tolerance. These results demonstrate stronger geometric adherence and higher observed task performance, supporting prescribed normal contraction as a complement to learned generative transport.

摘要（中文）：流动匹配（Flow Matching, FM）通过速度回归学习生成动力学过程。几何流动匹配变体通常假设先验分布支撑在数据流形上，这要求具备往往不可得的几何知识。在缺乏此类知识的情况下，仅凭低回归误差并不能保证流形依从性。流形依从性可使生成样本保持在有效构型内，并在经验上与更好的任务性能相关。我们提出了流形稳定流动匹配（Manifold-Stable Flow Matching, MSFM），该方法可从任意环境先验出发，无需该先验支撑在流形上。利用非线性动力学中的工具，即收缩理论，MSFM将学习得到的切向输运与预设的法向收缩相结合。该构造对已知流形使用解析投影算子，对未知数据几何则使用通过主成分分析估计的局部仿射近似。通过在已知和未知流形两种情形下实施收缩理论，我们保证了流形不变性以及在期望时间窗口（例如一秒）内横向收敛到流形。我们推导出一族相容的概率路径，并将训练损失分解为可学习的切向项与法向残差。一个椭圆实验实现了量级为$10^{-6}$的平均终端离流形误差。在Push-T机器人实验中，MSFM将成功率从$74\%$提升至$82\%$。在Robomimic Square任务中，成功率从$60\%$提升至$72\%$，同时旋转流形偏差从$10^{-2}$量级降至$10^{-7}$量级。MSFM的终端几何误差由所选的数值容差控制。这些结果展示了更强的几何依从性和更高的观测任务性能，支持将预设法向收缩作为学习生成输运的补充。

Authors: Amirhossein Nazerian, Ali Pezeshki, Jianguo Zhao

Revision, Not Restart: Revisable Visual Plans for Closed-Loop World-Action Models WorldModel

world-action model revisable visual planning closed-loop control revision bridge temporal planning

简要说明：本文提出可修订时序规划（RTP），将预测视觉未来作为持久动作条件，并通过学习到的修订桥在执行反馈后修订它，从而提升RoboMME和RMBench上的闭环任务成功率。

TLDR: This paper proposes Revisable Temporal Planning (RTP), a method for world-action models that treats the predicted visual future as a persistent action condition and revises it via a learned revision bridge after execution feedback, improving closed-loop task success rates on RoboMME and RMBench.

Abstract: World-action models use predicted visual futures to condition robot actions, yet execution feedback can invalidate parts of a prediction while leaving its task structure useful. We propose Revisable Temporal Planning (RTP), which maintains the visual future as a persistent action condition and revises it after feedback. Its central mechanism is a learned revision bridge: it resumes an intermediate state saved during visual generation and adapts its continuation to current observations. Visual and action supervision connect this revision to subsequent control. Time-aware history supplies observed evidence, and an adaptive policy selects retention, bridge revision, or fresh replanning from new noise before decoding the next action. On RoboMME and RMBench, RTP achieves task-averaged success rates of 48.6% and 84.8%, respectively. Matched comparisons support learned continuation; estimated checkpoint-source and action-prefix effects are positive but less precisely resolved. These results connect feedback-driven visual-plan revision to closed-loop task performance. Project Page: https://PLACEHOLDER.github.io/RTP/

摘要（中文）：世界-动作模型利用预测的未来视觉信息来调控机器人动作，然而执行反馈可能使预测中的部分内容失效，但任务结构仍具参考价值。我们提出可修正时序规划（Revisable Temporal Planning, RTP），该方法将视觉未来保持为持续的动作条件，并在反馈后对其进行修正。其核心机制是一个学习得到的修正桥（revision bridge）：它从视觉生成过程中保存的中间状态恢复，并根据当前观测调整其后续生成。视觉与动作监督将该修正过程与后续控制相连接。具备时间感知的历史信息提供观测证据，自适应策略在解码下一动作前，选择保留原有预测、进行桥接修正，或从新噪声中重新规划。在RoboMME和RMBench基准上，RTP分别取得了48.6%和84.8%的任务平均成功率。配对比较支持学习型延续机制；估计的检查点来源与动作前缀效应为正，但精度解析尚不够明确。这些结果将反馈驱动的视觉规划修正与闭环任务性能联系起来。项目页面：https://PLACEHOLDER.github.io/RTP/

Authors: Pengyiang Liu, Junbo Niu, Wenhao Zheng, Xinchen Chen, Canyu Li, Zhongyue Shi, Jiahao Xie, Si Liu

Adaptive Safety Filtering for Frozen ACC Policies via Conformal Residual Calibration AutonomousDriving

adaptive cruise control conformal prediction safety filtering CBF-QP residual calibration

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于共形残差校准的自适应安全过滤方法，用于冻结的自适应巡航控制策略，提高了安全性和计算效率。

TLDR: This paper introduces a conformal residual calibration method to adaptively filter actions from a frozen ACC policy, improving safety and reducing computation while preserving the base policy.

Abstract: Frozen adaptive cruise control (ACC) policies can violate constraints when deployment dynamics differ from their training conditions. We propose residual-aware conformal action filtering (RACF), which calibrates residuals of a fixed nominal predictor and converts their quantile into an operating margin for finite-model action projection. Completed transitions update margins and candidate selection without retraining the policy. In a registered comparison over 2,400 controller-trial units, Adaptive RACF achieves 94.3% episode safety, improving by 19.9 percentage points over the evaluated nominal CBF-QP baseline while reducing projection frequency from 8.11% to 6.63%. A controlled study isolates a 4.54-point improvement from residual-margin injection. In a separate matched-hardware evaluation, Adaptive reduces mean amortized rollout time by 21.2% relative to Robust CBF-QP, with 161/180 versus 170/180 safe episodes. We characterize conditions linking one-step residual coverage to constraint satisfaction and quantify the observed safety-computation trade-offs.

摘要（中文）：冻结的自适应巡航控制（ACC）策略在部署环境与其训练条件不一致时可能会违反约束。我们提出了一种残差感知共形动作滤波方法（RACF），该方法对固定标称预测器的残差进行校准，并将其分位数转化为有限模型动作投影的运行裕度。已完成的转移会更新裕度与候选选择，而无需重新训练策略。在包含2400个控制器试验单元的注册比较中，自适应RACF实现了94.3%的回合安全性，相较于评估的标称CBF-QP基线提升了19.9个百分点，同时将投影频率从8.11%降至6.63%。一项对照研究单独分离出残差裕度注入带来的4.54个百分点改进。在另一项匹配硬件评估中，自适应方法相较于鲁棒CBF-QP将平均摊还展开时间降低了21.2%，安全回合数分别为161/180和170/180。我们刻画了将一步残差覆盖与约束满足联系起来的相关条件，并量化了所观察到的安全性与计算量之间的权衡。

Authors: Zhiruo Zhou, Rigaudiere Z. Li, Chen Xiwen, Yucheng Chen, Xiaojun Zhu, Houde Liu

QuadHand: A Compact Quadrotor Aerial Manipulator with MRC-SDF-Based Whole-Body Motion Planning Manipulation

quadrotor aerial manipulator MRC-SDF whole-body trajectory optimization CoG compensation aerial manipulation

简要说明：QuadHand 提出了一种带有3自由度机械臂和无源重心补偿模块的紧凑型四旋翼空中机械臂，并利用新颖的 MRC-SDF 表示和全身轨迹优化实现了复杂环境中的安全空中操作。

TLDR: QuadHand presents a compact quadrotor aerial manipulator with a 3-DoF arm and passive CoG compensation, along with a novel MRC-SDF representation and whole-body trajectory optimization for safe aerial manipulation in complex environments.

Abstract: Uncrewed aerial manipulators (UAMs) integrate robotic arms with aerial platforms for three-dimensional physical interaction. However, enlarging the workspace increases arm-induced disturbances, while existing geometric representations face a trade-off between geometric fidelity and computational efficiency in close-proximity interaction. This paper presents QuadHand, a compact quadrotor aerial manipulator with a 3-DoF arm, gripper, and battery-assisted passive CoG compensation module to reduce dominant arm-induced disturbances. We further propose MRC-SDF, a Multi-articulated Robot-Centric Signed Distance Field that preserves fine geometric detail with tractable computation, and a spatiotemporal whole-body trajectory optimization framework that jointly optimizes the quadrotor and manipulator for safe and executable trajectory generation. Simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate safe and executable aerial manipulation in complex environments.

摘要（中文）：无人飞行操纵器（UAMs）将机械臂与空中平台相结合，用于三维物理交互。然而，工作空间的增大会增加机械臂引起的扰动，而现有几何表示在近距离交互中面临几何保真度与计算效率之间的权衡。本文提出了QuadHand，一种紧凑型四旋翼空中操纵器，配备三自由度机械臂、夹爪及电池辅助的被动质心补偿模块，以减少机械臂引起的显著扰动。我们进一步提出了MRC-SDF，一种多关节机器人中心符号距离场，可在计算量可控的情况下保留精细几何细节，并构建了一种时空全身轨迹优化框架，该框架联合优化四旋翼与机械臂，以实现安全且可执行的轨迹生成。仿真与真实世界实验证明了在复杂环境中进行安全且可执行的空中操纵的可行性。

Authors: Rui Jin, Ruiyang Liu, Xinhang Xu, Haotian Jin, Yi Wang, Yizhuo Yang, Lihua Xi

Graph-Based Simultaneous Path and Foothold Planning for Multi-Limbed Intra-Vehicular Robots in Space Stations Locomotion

graph-based planning foothold planning multi-limbed robot intra-vehicular robot space station

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于图的规划框架，可同时为空间站内多臂机器人规划路径和支撑点序列，并在国际空间站舱内仿真中验证了其有效性。

TLDR: This paper presents a graph-based planning framework that simultaneously determines paths and foothold sequences for multi-limbed intra-vehicular robots operating in space stations, validated in a simulated ISS cabin.

Abstract: Robot-aided operations in space stations are essential for reducing the workload of astronauts and improving the efficiency of on-orbit activities. Multi-limbed intra-vehicular robots (MLIVRs) equipped with grappling end-effectors have emerged as a promising solution, as they can securely grasp pre-existing interfaces, such as handrails and seat tracks, thereby enabling stable locomotion and forceful manipulation in microgravity environments. Since graspable locations on these interfaces are spatially limited and discretely distributed, motion planning for MLIVRs must be addressed jointly with foothold planning. This paper presents a simultaneous path and foothold planning framework based on graph theory for MLIVRs. The proposed method efficiently searches for feasible stance sequences for a multi-limbed robot while satisfying manipulability constraints. The effectiveness of the proposed framework is validated through simulations in a 3D model of the International Space Station (ISS) cabin, demonstrating its capability to generate feasible and efficient locomotion plans in realistic intra-vehicular environments.

摘要（中文）：空间站中的机器人辅助操作对于减轻航天员工作负担、提升在轨活动效率具有重要意义。配备抓取式末端执行器的多臂舱内机器人（MLIVRs）因其能够牢固抓取扶手、座椅滑轨等既有接口，从而在微重力环境中实现稳定移动与强力操作，已成为一种有前景的解决方案。由于这些接口上可抓取位置在空间上有限且呈离散分布，MLIVRs的运动规划必须与立足点规划联合进行。本文提出了一种基于图论的MLIVRs路径与立足点同步规划框架。该方法在满足可操作约束的同时，高效搜索多臂机器人的可行支撑序列。通过在国际空间站（ISS）舱段三维模型中的仿真验证，证明了该框架在真实舱内环境中生成可行且高效运动规划的能力。

Authors: Masazumi Imai, Kentaro Uno, Toshinori Kuwahara, Kazuya Yoshida

NavJev: Efficient Vision-Language Navigation via Action-Centric Visual Compression and Discriminative Action-Semantic Memory VLN

zero-shot VLN action-centric visual compression action-semantic memory MLLM efficiency R2R-CE

简要说明：NavJev 通过动作中心的视觉压缩和判别性记忆替代重复的 MLLM 推理，提高了视觉语言导航的效率，在显著降低延迟和成本的同时实现了较高的成功率。

TLDR: NavJev improves Vision-and-Language Navigation efficiency by replacing repeated MLLM inference with action-centric visual compression and a discriminative memory, achieving strong success rates at drastically lower latency and cost.

Abstract: Recent zero-shot Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) methods increasingly rely on multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to reason over visual observations, navigation instructions, and candidate actions. Although effective, repeatedly invoking autoregressive multimodal reasoning at every navigation step introduces substantial inference latency, limiting the responsiveness of embodied agents. We propose NavJev, an efficient VLN framework that reformulates online navigation from repeated multimodal generation into compact visual compression followed by lightweight typed action selection. Specifically, Action-Centric Visual Compression (ACVC) integrates waypoint geometry, BLIP captions, and RAM semantic tags into compact representations of candidate actions, while Discriminative Action-Semantic Memory (DASM) filters shared semantics and maintains discriminative action-specific evidence across navigation steps. Based on these representations, Jev directly performs structured probabilistic decisions over the available action set. Experiments on R2R-CE show that NavJev achieves 27.0% SR and 22.4% SPL with only 0.65 s per navigation step, while substantially reducing inference latency and cost compared with MLLM-based VLN methods. The project page is available at https://kai-sheng-caesar.github.io/NavJev/.

摘要（中文）：近期，零样本视觉与语言导航（VLN）方法日益依赖多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）来对视觉观察、导航指令及候选动作进行推理。尽管这些方法效果显著，但在每个导航步骤中反复调用自回归多模态推理会带来大量推理延迟，限制了具身智能体的响应能力。为此，我们提出了NavJev，一种高效的VLN框架，将在线导航从重复的多模态生成任务重构为紧凑的视觉压缩加轻量级类型化动作选择。具体而言，动作中心视觉压缩（ACVC）将途径点几何信息、BLIP描述及RAM语义标签整合为候选动作的紧凑表示，而判别性动作-语义记忆（DASM）则在各导航步骤间过滤共享语义，维持具有区分性的动作特定证据。基于这些表示，Jev直接对可用动作集进行结构化概率决策。在R2R-CE上的实验表明，NavJev实现了27.0%的SR和22.4%的SPL，且每步导航仅需0.65秒，与基于MLLM的VLN方法相比，大幅降低了推理延迟与成本。项目页面见 https://kai-sheng-caesar.github.io/NavJev/。

Authors: Kai Sheng, Liuyi Wang, Jinlong Li, Haojie Dai, Chengju Liu, Qijun Chen

AGRO-SUVIDE: Agentic Robotics for Surgical Viscoelastic Debridement Manipulation

agentic robotics surgical robotics skill decomposition da Vinci Research Kit debridement

简要说明：AGRO-SUVIDE 提出了一种用于外科粘弹性清创的代理式机器人框架，利用代理编程和模块化技能在达芬奇研究套件上实现85%的单片段移除成功率。

TLDR: AGRO-SUVIDE presents an agentic robotics framework for surgical viscoelastic debridement, using agent coding and modular skills to achieve 85% single-fragment removal success on the da Vinci Research Kit across 340 physical trials.

Abstract: Augmented dexterity has the potential to reduce the fatigue experienced by surgeons during repetitive surgical tasks. In this paper, we propose the first AGentic RObotics framework for SUrgical VIscoelastic DEbridement (AGRO-SUVIDE), the repeated removal of small fragments attached to a viscoelastic substrate. Leveraging the self-improving and coding capability of agents, AGRO-SUVIDE adopts a modular framework. Specifically, the demonstration analysis module automatically identifies recurring skills from a single expert demonstration, using both visual and kinematic information. The construction module then builds each skill, either as a procedural model-based skill the agent codes against a scaffolded library or as a model-free policy-based skill. At runtime, the monitoring module composes the skills into a loop-style graph sized to the number of fragments it observes, then verifies pre- and post-conditions of each skill to decide whether to advance or retry. We evaluate AGRO-SUVIDE through 340 physical trials on the da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK). AGRO-SUVIDE achieves an average single-fragment removal success rate of 85%, completing consecutive three-fragment removal at 60% and at 95% with one human intervention. It further generalizes to unseen five-fragment scenarios with an average success rate of 80% for single-fragment removal. Project page: https://surgical-robotics.github.io/AGRO-SUVIDE/

摘要（中文）：增强灵巧性有潜力减少外科医生在执行重复性外科任务时所经历的疲劳。本文提出了首个用于外科粘弹性清创术的智能体机器人框架（AGRO-SUVIDE），该任务涉及反复移除附着在粘弹性基质上的小碎片。利用智能体的自我改进与编码能力，AGRO-SUVIDE采用模块化框架。具体而言，示范分析模块利用视觉和运动信息，从单次专家示范中自动识别重复出现的技能。构建模块随后构建每项技能，既可作为基于过程模型的技能（智能体根据脚手架库进行编码），也可作为基于无模型策略的技能。在运行时，监控模块将技能组合成循环式图结构，其规模与观察到的碎片数量相匹配，然后验证每项技能的前置条件和后置条件，以决定是继续推进还是重试。我们通过达芬奇研究套件（dVRK）上的340次物理试验对AGRO-SUVIDE进行了评估。AGRO-SUVIDE实现了85%的平均单碎片移除成功率，连续移除三个碎片的成功率为60%，在一次人工干预下可达95%。它进一步泛化到未见过的五碎片场景，单碎片移除的平均成功率为80%。项目页面：https://surgical-robotics.github.io/AGRO-SUVIDE/

Authors: Shutong Jin, Ziyang Chen, Preethi Satish, Meadow Shen, Gary Guthart, Florian T. Pokorny, Ken Goldberg

SOR-Nav: Search or Relocate? Context-Gated Exploration and Cross-Region Relocation for Object Navigation VLN

object navigation LLM-driven decision semantic exploration cross-region relocation hierarchical navigation

简要说明：SOR-Nav 提出了一种层次化目标导航系统，利用 LLM 驱动的监督器在继续探索当前区域与迁移至更有前景的区域之间进行决策，在 HM3D 和 MP3D 基准上取得了最优结果，并展示了真实世界部署。

TLDR: SOR-Nav presents a hierarchical object navigation system that uses an LLM-driven supervisor to decide between exploring the current area or relocating to a more promising region, achieving state-of-the-art results on HM3D and MP3D benchmarks and demonstrating real-world deployment.

Abstract: Object navigation requires an embodied agent to find an object in an unseen environment under partial observability and a limited motion budget. Existing methods primarily optimize where the robot should go next by ranking candidate destinations. In contrast to these methods, we present SOR-Nav, a hierarchical navigation system that explicitly arbitrates between continuing to explore the current context and abandoning it for a more promising reachable region. First, an autonomous semantic exploration system is built that accumulates persistent 3D object clusters and organizes reachable frontiers into a cluster decision graph to provide an efficient search abstraction. Then, SOR-Nav uses a context-gated LLM-driven object-search supervisor to evaluate the suitability of the current search context and decide whether to continue exploration or perform cross-region relocation to another reachable frontier cluster. Across the complete, unfiltered validation sets of HM3D-v1, HM3D-v2, and MP3D, SOR-Nav achieves the strongest reported Success Rate (SR) and Success weighted by Path Length (SPL) on all three benchmarks. On MP3D in particular, it more than doubles the previous best SPL from 18.1\% to 38.5\% while increasing SR from 50.7\% to 61.8\%. Nested HM3D-v2 ablations validate the proposed decision structure, while a continuous three-target physical deployment demonstrates persistent ObjectNav operation in real-world scenarios.

摘要（中文）：目标导航要求具身智能体在部分可观测且运动预算有限的条件下，于未见环境中寻找目标物体。现有方法主要通过排名候选目的地来优化机器人下一步的移动方向。与此不同，我们提出SOR-Nav，一种分层导航系统，显式地在继续探索当前情境与放弃当前情境转而前往更有潜力的可达区域之间进行仲裁。首先，构建自主语义探索系统，该系统累积持久的三维物体簇，并将可达前沿组织为簇决策图，以提供高效的搜索抽象。随后，SOR-Nav利用情境门控的大语言模型驱动的物体搜索监督器，评估当前搜索情境的适宜性，并决定是继续探索还是跨区域转移到另一个可达前沿簇。在HM3D-v1、HM3D-v2和MP3D的完整未过滤验证集上，SOR-Nav在所有三个基准测试中均取得了已报告的最高成功率（SR）和路径长度加权成功率（SPL）。特别是在MP3D上，其将此前最优SPL从18.1\%提升至38.5\%，实现翻倍以上增长，同时将SR从50.7\%提升至61.8\%。嵌套的HM3D-v2消融实验验证了所提出的决策结构，而连续三目标物理部署则展示了真实场景中的持久目标导航运行能力。

Authors: Yuan Ji, Zirui Li, Yuxin Cai, Shuge Wu, Boon Siew Han, Chen Lv

HOI-Retarget: Contact-Centric Retargeting for Human-Object Interaction HumanoidEmbodied

contact-centric retargeting human-object interaction humanoid robot trajectory optimization motion-data generation

简要说明：HOI-Retarget 是一种以接触为中心的重定向方法，通过窗口轨迹优化将人-物交互迁移到人形机器人上，支持大规模运动数据生成。它能够处理单目视频接触、物体尺寸变化以及多机器人操作场景，并公开了代码和数据集。

TLDR: HOI-Retarget is a contact-centric retargeting method that transfers human-object interactions onto humanoid robots via windowed trajectory optimization, enabling large-scale motion-data generation for learning demonstrations. It handles monocular video contacts, object-size variation, and multi-robot manipulation scenarios, with released code and datasets.

Abstract: Learning from demonstration (LfD) has enabled humanoid robots to acquire diverse whole-body skills, but extending this paradigm to human-object interaction (HOI) is limited by the availability of robot-compatible interaction references. We present HOI-Retarget, a contact-centric retargeting method that transfers HOI onto a humanoid robot for large-scale motion-data generation. Its windowed trajectory optimization uses every labeled contact as a target in the object frame, balancing body tracking, foot support and smoothness under the robot's kinematic limits. The method can augment a single demonstration across object sizes, absorb contacts reconstructed from monocular video, and extend to several robots manipulating one object. We publicly release the code and the retargeted motion dataset.

摘要（中文）：从演示中学习（LfD）使仿人机器人能够获取多样化的全身技能，但将该范式扩展至人-物交互（HOI）受到机器人兼容交互参考数据可用性的限制。我们提出HOI-Retarget，一种以接触为中心的重定向方法，将人-物交互迁移至仿人机器人，用于大规模运动数据生成。其窗口化轨迹优化将每个标注接触点作为物体坐标系中的目标，在机器人运动学约束下平衡身体跟踪、足部支撑与平滑性。该方法可对单一演示进行跨物体尺寸的增强，吸收从单目视频重建的接触信息，并支持多机器人协同操作同一物体。我们公开发布了代码及重定向运动数据集。

Authors: Jihwan Shin, Adrià López Escoriza, Junzhe He, Matthias Heyrman, Marco Hutter

On the Numerical Reliability of Differentiable Physics-Based Optimization for Robotic Material Manipulation Manipulation

differentiable physics material point method system identification numerical reliability robotic material manipulation

简要说明：该论文研究了机器人材料操作中基于可微物理优化的数值可靠性问题，通过MPM基准测试识别系统参数，揭示了梯度不稳定性、有限差分校验不可靠以及对观测定义的敏感性等问题。

TLDR: This paper investigates numerical reliability issues in differentiable physics-based optimization for robotic material manipulation, specifically using MPM benchmarks for system identification, and reveals gradient instability, unreliable finite-difference checks, and sensitivity to observation definitions.

Abstract: Differentiable physics is increasingly used in robotic material manipulation for system identification, trajectory or skill optimization, demonstration generation, and robot or end-effector design. These applications depend on gradients propagated through long, contact-rich simulation rollouts. We study the numerical reliability of those gradients using two Material Point Method (MPM) system-identification benchmarks derived from elastoplastic and granular manipulation. The benchmarks provide controlled cases for three effects that also arise in broader differentiable physics-based optimization. GPU many-to-one sums whose order depends on thread scheduling changed long-horizon gradients and reversed the sign of one parameter gradient relative to a deterministic reference. Finite-difference checks became less reliable for longer rollouts because repeated-run loss variation grew much faster than the loss change produced by the tested parameter perturbations. Observation and loss definitions changed optimization behaviour and the solution preferred by an independent metric. These results motivate reproducible accumulation, finite-difference validation that compares perturbation-induced loss changes with repeated-run variation, and explicit reporting of objective construction when differentiable simulation is used for robotic optimization.

摘要（中文）：可微物理（differentiable physics）日益被用于机器人材料操控中的系统辨识、轨迹或技能优化、演示生成以及机器人或末端执行器设计等领域。这些应用依赖于通过长时程、富含接触的仿真推演所传播的梯度。我们利用两个基于弹塑性和颗粒操控的材料点法（Material Point Method, MPM）系统辨识基准，研究了这些梯度的数值可靠性。所构建的基准为三类现象提供了受控测试案例，这些现象同样出现在更广泛的基于可微物理的优化中。GPU上多对一求和（其顺序取决于线程调度）会改变长时程梯度的结果，并使某一参数梯度相对于确定性参考发生符号反转。对于更长推演，有限差分校验的可靠性下降，因为重复运行导致的损失方差增长远快于所测试参数扰动引起的损失变化。观测定义和损失定义会改变优化行为以及独立指标所偏好的解。这些结果促使我们采用可复现的累加方式，在有限差分验证中比较扰动引起的损失变化与重复运行方差，并在使用可微仿真进行机器人优化时明确报告目标函数的构建方式。

Authors: Xintong Yang, Minglun Wei, Yu-Kun Lai, Ze Ji

Efficient World Action Model Inference with Adaptive Intermediate States WorldModel

World Action Model inference acceleration intermediate states diffusion/flow denoising closed-loop control

简要说明：本文提出WAMACHINE，一种无需训练、通过保留并自适应中间推理状态来加速世界动作模型（WAM）推理的框架，在LIBERO和RoboTwin基准上实现1.47-3.05倍延迟和2.23-3.27倍GPU时间加速，同时保持任务成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces WAMACHINE, a training-free framework that accelerates World Action Model inference by preserving and adapting intermediate inference states across control loop replans, denoising steps, and Transformer layers, achieving significant speedups on LIBERO and RoboTwin benchmarks while preserving task success.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) enable future-aware control by jointly modeling actions and environment dynamics. However, iterative diffusion or flow inference incurs substantial denoising latency. Prior inference state offers a natural opportunity for acceleration, yet changing planning contexts, observations, and intermediate representations can quickly render retained state stale. Preserving useful computation therefore requires adapting inference state rather than reusing it as-is. To this end, we present $\mathrm{WAM}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{ACHINE}}$, a training-free framework that accelerates WAM inference by preserving and adapting inference state for efficient and accurate continuation as the control loop evolves. Across closed-loop replans, Trajectory Remapping remaps replan state from the preceding replan to initialize the next replan, reducing redundant trajectory generation. Across denoising steps, Observation Rebinding performs anticipatory inference during action execution and rebinds retained denoising state to the real observation for continuation when consistency checks pass, reducing latency exposed to the control loop. Across Transformer layers, Residual Rescaling selectively rescales retained layer state and refreshes it through full computation of the middle layers when probe checks fail, reducing repeated Transformer computation. Evaluations of three representative WAM architectures on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 show that $\mathrm{WAM}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{ACHINE}}$ achieves 1.47-3.05$\times$ speedups in observation-to-action latency and 2.23-3.27$\times$ speedups in GPU inference time per replan, while preserving 96.69-99.54% of native WAM task success.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）通过联合建模动作与环境动态，实现了具有前瞻性的控制。然而，迭代式扩散或流推理引入了大量的去噪延迟。先前的推理状态为加速提供了天然机会，但规划情境、观测数据及中间表示的不断变化，可能使保留的状态迅速失效。因此，保留有效计算需要调整推理状态，而非直接复用。为此，我们提出$\mathrm{WAM}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{ACHINE}}$，一个无需训练的框架，通过保留并适配推理状态，在控制循环演化过程中实现高效且准确的连续推理。在闭环重规划层面，轨迹重映射将前一次重规划的状态重新映射以初始化下一次重规划，减少冗余的轨迹生成。在去噪步骤层面，观测重绑定在动作执行期间进行预期推理，并在一致性检查通过时将保留的去噪状态与真实观测重新绑定以继续推理，从而减少暴露于控制循环的延迟。在Transformer层层面，残差缩放选择性地调整保留的层状态，并在探针检查失败时通过中间层的完整计算刷新状态，减少重复的Transformer计算。在LIBERO和RoboTwin 2.0上对三种代表性WAM架构的评估表明，$\mathrm{WAM}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{ACHINE}}$在观测到动作的延迟上实现了1.47–3.05$\times$的加速，在每次重规划的GPU推理时间上实现了2.23–3.27$\times$的加速，同时保留了原生WAM任务成功率的96.69–99.54%。

Authors: Zhinnan Liu, Haozhi Han, Ruge Zhang, Teng Ma, Tao Ma, Zheng Liu, Yifeng Chen, Yunquan Zhang, Ting Cao, Yunxin Liu, Kun Li

Aerial GRIPPER: A Gradient-based Real-time Inverse-game Predictor and Planner Manipulation

aerial manipulation inverse game pursuit-evasion receding-horizon control real-time planning

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于空中抓取器的实时逆博弈规划器，通过梯度优化和抗扰动控制实现对非合作目标的捕获，并在仿真和真实实验中验证了其高效性和鲁棒性。

TLDR: This paper presents a real-time inverse-game planner for an aerial gripper to capture non-cooperative targets, using gradient-based optimization and anti-disturbance control, validated in simulations and real-world experiments.

Abstract: Accurate capture of non-cooperative targets is critical. In an attempt to tackle this intractable challenge, an aerial gripper system integrated with a Gradient-based Real-time Inverse-game Predictor and PlannER (GRIPPER) framework is proposed. The interaction is formulated as a general-sum pursuit-evasion game under incomplete information. Specifically, underlying cost parameters of the target are inferred online, and the open-loop Nash equilibrium (OLNE) strategy is iteratively refined within a receding-horizon loop. To ensure high-frequency execution, a computationally friendly gradient-based inverse-game solver is developed. Without explicit computation of the Hessian inverse, the optimized solution is updated (> 50 Hz) based on implicit differentiation and fast Hessian-vector products. Meanwhile, an anti-disturbance controller is developed to overcome disturbances of uncertain payload and gripper actuation, enabling precise tracking of the planned trajectory and accurate grasping of the target. Simulations and real-world experiments illustrate the superior computational efficiency and task performance of GRIPPER. The task of capturing and delivering a non-cooperative target is accomplished, highlighting the robustness, adaptability, and real-time performance of the framework in highly adversarial scenarios.

摘要（中文）：精确捕获非合作目标至关重要。为应对这一棘手挑战，本文提出了一种集成基于梯度的实时逆博弈预测与规划器（GRIPPER）框架的空中抓取系统。该交互过程被建模为不完全信息条件下的广义和追逃博弈。具体而言，目标潜在的代价参数被在线推断，并在滚动时域循环中迭代优化开环纳什均衡（OLNE）策略。为确保高频执行，开发了一种计算友好的基于梯度的逆博弈求解器。该求解器无需显式计算Hessian逆矩阵，而是基于隐式微分和快速Hessian向量积实现优化解的高频更新（>50 Hz）。同时，设计了抗扰动控制器以克服不确定载荷和抓取器驱动带来的扰动，从而实现对规划轨迹的精确跟踪和目标抓取的精准执行。仿真与实物实验验证了GRIPPER框架优越的计算效率和任务性能。成功完成了非合作目标的捕获与递送任务，突显了该框架在高度对抗场景下的鲁棒性、适应性和实时性能。

Authors: Zeshuai Chen, Meng Wang, Jindou Jia, Xiang Yu, Lei Guo

Gaze Prompts: Temporally Dense Human Attention for Vision-Language-Action Fine-Tuning Manipulation

VLA fine-tuning gaze prompting VR teleoperation bimanual manipulation visual guidance

简要说明：本文提出了凝视提示方法，通过眼动仪监督在VLA微调期间提供帧级视觉指导，提高了真实世界双臂操作任务的成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces gaze prompting, an eye-tracker-supervised method that provides frame-level visual guidance during VLA fine-tuning, improving success rates on real-world bimanual manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) fine-tuning pairs images with actions at every step, yet typically provides only a task-level language instruction, leaving moment-to-moment visual relevance implicit. We introduce \emph{eye-tracker-supervised gaze prompting}, which uses gaze recorded during VR teleoperation to provide frame-level visual guidance for VLA fine-tuning. During training, recorded gaze locations are rendered as crosshairs on the robot's head-camera images. At deployment, a lightweight predictor estimates gaze locations from recent images and the instruction, supplying the same type of visual prompt without an eye tracker or changes to the policy architecture. Instantiated with $π_0$, gaze prompting increases mean success from $26.3\%$ to $56.0\%$ across six real-world bimanual manipulation tasks, with gains also observed when a single policy is trained on all six tasks. We release \textsc{GazeMani}, a dataset of $1{,}200$ teleoperated trajectories with synchronized gaze.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）微调在每一步都将图像与动作配对，但通常仅提供任务级别的语言指令，使得逐时刻的视觉相关性隐而不显。我们提出了一种基于眼动追踪监督的注视提示方法，利用虚拟现实遥操作过程中记录的眼动数据，为VLA微调提供帧级别的视觉引导。在训练阶段，记录到的注视位置以十字准星的形式渲染在机器人头部摄像头的图像上。在部署阶段，一个轻量级预测器根据近期图像和指令估计注视位置，在不使用眼动仪或改变策略架构的前提下，提供相同类型的视觉提示。以π₀为模型实例，注视提示在六个真实世界双臂操作任务中将平均成功率从26.3%提升至56.0%，并且在单一策略同时训练所有六个任务时也观察到了性能提升。我们发布了\textsc{GazeMani}数据集，包含1,200条带有同步眼动数据的遥操作轨迹。

Authors: Yihan Zhou, Rui Yan, Mingcong Li, Zheyuan Huang, Xu Yang, Xueyang Guo, Yilin Mo

ARS: Agentic Reward System for Robot Learning Other

progress reward modeling vision-language models reward verification policy learning offline trajectory

简要说明：ARS是一个推理框架，利用27B视觉语言模型通过自适应视觉检查和验证来估计离线轨迹中的逐帧任务进度奖励，无需额外奖励模型训练即可提升模拟和真实机器人上的策略学习。

TLDR: ARS is an inference framework that uses a 27B VLM with adaptive visual inspection and verification to estimate per-frame task progress rewards from offline trajectories, improving reward modeling and policy learning in simulation and on a real robot without extra reward-model training.

Abstract: Progress reward modeling is the problem of estimating how a robot's behavior changes task progress over time. Reliable estimation requires distinguishing meaningful state changes from failed attempts and task-irrelevant actions. We introduce the Agentic Reward System (ARS), an inference framework for progress reward modeling with general-purpose vision-language models (VLMs), without additional reward-model training. Given an offline trajectory and a task instruction, ARS uses adaptive visual inspection for both event proposal and verification. A subagent proposes a task-relevant event timeline, which a primary agent verifies and revises before estimating per-frame progress. ARS can incorporate optional terminal outcome labels and visual references to inform its judgments. It can also audit progress estimates from external reward models. We evaluate ARS with a 27B VLM on a controlled semantic-mismatch benchmark and downstream policy learning in simulation and on a real robot. The benchmark reveals that several evaluated reward baselines assign spurious progress to wrong-object manipulation even in simple pick-and-place scenes. ARS better suppresses these errors and outperforms these baselines in simulation policy learning. We further demonstrate that ARS supports long-horizon policy learning from mixed-quality offline experience on real-robot multi-screw fastening in a full-scale laboratory replica of an industrial washing-machine assembly line. These results suggest that structured inference and verification can improve the usefulness of general-purpose VLMs for robot reward modeling. Code is at https://github.com/midea-ai/ars

摘要（中文）：进度奖励建模是估计机器人行为如何随时间改变任务进度的问题。可靠估计要求区分有意义的状态变化与失败尝试及与任务无关的动作。我们提出了智能体奖励系统（ARS），一种利用通用视觉语言模型（VLM）进行进度奖励建模的推理框架，无需额外的奖励模型训练。给定离线轨迹和任务指令，ARS采用自适应视觉检查进行事件提议和验证。一个子智能体提出与任务相关的事件时间线，主智能体在估算逐帧进度前对其进行验证和修订。ARS可结合可选的终端结果标签和视觉参考以辅助判断，还能审计外部奖励模型的进度估计。我们在受控语义失配基准测试、仿真环境及真实机器人上的下游策略学习中，使用27B规模的VLM对ARS进行了评估。基准测试表明，即使在简单的抓取-放置场景中，多个被评估的奖励基线也会将虚假进度归因于错误物体的操作。ARS能更好地抑制这些错误，并在仿真策略学习中优于这些基线。我们进一步证明，ARS支持在真实机器人上，利用混合质量的离线经验进行多螺丝紧固这一工业洗衣机装配线全尺寸实验室复制环境中的长时程策略学习。这些结果表明，结构化推理与验证能够提升通用VLM在机器人奖励建模中的实用性。代码见https://github.com/midea-ai/ars

Authors: Sheng Hu, Weiyi Lu, Lingbing Zeng, Gan Weng, Weiwei Zhang, Kai Xie, Xiaofeng Mou, Yi Xu

When the Score Becomes the Target: Rethinking Metric Validity in Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

metric validity score optimization closed-loop evaluation autonomous driving scoring process

简要说明：本文探讨了在直接优化自动驾驶基准分数时，分数提升是否仍是驾驶改进的可靠证据，通过分解评分过程表明在不同执行接口下分数提升可能逆转。

TLDR: This paper investigates whether autonomous driving benchmark score gains remain reliable evidence of improvement when scores are directly optimized, decomposing the scoring process and showing that gains can reverse under different execution interfaces.

Abstract: Driving benchmark scores are increasingly used not only for evaluation but also as optimization targets. This raises a fundamental question: do score gains remain reliable evidence of driving improvement once the score itself is optimized? We address this question by examining how the scoring process responds to changes in driving behavior and whether the resulting gains persist under repeated execution and replanning. We decompose the process into execution, measurement, subscore mapping, and aggregation. Controlled interventions reveal substantial behavioral changes that receive little score response because distinctions are omitted, thresholded, or attenuated between requested and executed motion. Closed-loop comparisons further show that optimization gains can reverse when the execution interface changes, demonstrating their dependence on how requests are executed and returned as feedback. Together, these findings connect the behavioral distinctions preserved by a metric to the conditions under which its gains transfer. Metric validity under optimization therefore requires examining both what the scoring process measures and how the optimized behavior is executed.

摘要（中文）：驾驶基准分数日益被用于评估和优化目标。这引发了一个根本性问题：一旦分数本身成为优化对象，分数提升是否仍能作为驾驶改进的可靠证据？我们通过考察评分过程如何响应驾驶行为的变化，以及这些提升在重复执行和重新规划下是否持续存在，来解答这一问题。我们将该过程分解为执行、测量、子分数映射和聚合。受控干预揭示了显著的行为变化，但这些变化在评分中几乎未获响应，原因在于请求动作与实际执行动作之间的差异被省略、阈值化或衰减。闭环比较进一步表明，当执行接口改变时，优化增益可能发生逆转，这显示了增益对请求如何被执行并反馈回来的依赖性。综上，这些发现将评分指标所保留的行为差异与其增益可迁移的条件联系起来。因此，优化条件下的指标有效性要求同时检验评分过程所测量的内容以及优化行为如何被执行。

Authors: Morui Zhu, Deyuan Qu, Qi Chen, Kentaro Oguchi, Qing Yang

From Language to Task Maps: Compiling Semantic Relations While Preserving Task-Relevant Freedom Manipulation

semantic-to-geometric interface conformal geometric algebra RMPflow task maps Franka Emika Panda

简要说明：本文提出了一种类型化的语义到几何接口，将自然语言操作指令编译为任务地图和策略，同时保留任务相关的自由度，并在仿真机器人实验中进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces a typed semantic-to-geometric interface that compiles natural-language manipulation instructions into task maps and policies, preserving task-relevant freedoms, and validates it in simulated robot experiments.

Abstract: Natural-language manipulation instructions specify qualitative relations, whereas continuous controllers require state-evaluable task quantities, differentials, and completion conditions. Because a qualitative relation generally leaves part of the relative configuration unspecified, expanding it into a complete pose can introduce unintended constraints. We present a typed semantic-to-geometric interface in which language specifies entities, relations, and phases, while each relation indexes a registered specification of its task-relevant distinctions and preserved freedoms. A robot-side compiler grounds these specifications, constructs relation-specific task maps and consistent differentials using conformal geometric algebra, and composes the resulting policies through RMPflow. To evaluate the division of responsibility between the language model and the compiler, we compared a Semantic Topology interface with one that additionally requires relation-specific geometric specifications over 60 instructions. Both produced correct shared semantic content in 41/60 cases, but critical errors under their respective interface requirements occurred in 19/60 and 58/60 cases. Across 64 grounded evaluations spanning eight geometric relation forms, the task maps preserved registered null directions and responded to relation-relevant perturbations; analytic directional derivatives agreed with finite differences, and Jacobian ranks matched the registered dimensions. In three closed-loop ablations using a simulated Franka Emika Panda in MuJoCo, fixing a relation-preserved coordinate increased median terminal progress error by 20.24--71.00~mm while the retained relation errors remained within their evaluation bounds. These results support compiling relation-visible geometry and preserved freedom together into composable continuous objectives.

摘要（中文）：自然语言操作指令通常描述定性关系，而连续控制器则需要可状态评估的任务量、微分项及完成条件。由于定性关系通常未完全指定相对构型中的部分内容，将其展开为完整位姿可能会引入非预期的约束。我们提出了一种类型化的语义—几何接口，其中语言指定实体、关系及阶段，而每种关系索引其任务相关区分与保持自由度的注册规范。机器人端编译器对这些规范进行落地，利用共形几何代数构建关系特定的任务映射与一致的微分项，并通过RMPflow组合所得策略。为评估语言模型与编译器之间的职责分工，我们对比了语义拓扑接口与额外要求关系特定几何规范的接口，后者覆盖60条指令。两者在41/60情况下生成了正确的共享语义内容，但在各自接口要求下的关键错误分别出现在19/60和58/60情况下。在涵盖八种几何关系形式的64项落地评估中，任务映射保持了注册的零方向，并对关系相关扰动产生响应；解析方向导数与有限差分结果一致，雅可比矩阵秩与注册维度匹配。在使用MuJoCo中模拟Franka Emika Panda的三项闭环消融实验中，固定一个关系保持坐标使中位终端进度误差增加了20.24至71.00毫米，而保留关系误差仍保持在评估界限内。这些结果支持将关系可见的几何与保持自由度共同编译为可组合的连续目标函数。

Authors: Jaegyun Park, Jingwang Lee, Jungsoo Lee, Soonwoong Hwang, Wansoo Kim

Contact-Aware Impedance Controller for Robot-Assisted Ultrasound Imaging Manipulation

contact-aware impedance controller robot-assisted ultrasound imaging B-mode ultrasound contact localization force/torque taring

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于机器人辅助超声成像的接触感知阻抗控制器，利用B模式超声图像进行接触检测与定位，在成像过程中降低了交互力。

TLDR: This paper presents a contact-aware impedance controller for robot-assisted ultrasound imaging that uses B-mode ultrasound images for contact detection and localization, reducing interaction forces during imaging.

Abstract: Safe robot-assisted ultrasound imaging requires a reliable controller able to detect and localize probe--tissue interaction. In this paper, we present a B-mode ultrasound image-based contact perception method and a contact-aware impedance controller for robotic ultrasound imaging. The proposed method detects acoustic contact independently of force measurements, enabling contact-conditioned force/torque taring to reduce residual wrench bias. During contact, the method continuously estimates the effective contact location along the curved probe surface and uses it to update the controller interaction frame, enabling visual servoing of the physical probe--tissue contact point during imaging. Experiments on an agar phantom demonstrated a contact-localization RMSE of $\mathbf{1.46 \pm 0.14}$~mm over probe roll angles from $\mathbf{-15^\circ}$ to $\mathbf{15^\circ}$. During static rolling, the proposed controller maintained task-space tracking accuracy comparable to a conventional fixed-frame impedance controller while reducing the maximum compressive interaction force from $\mathbf{31.56}$~N to $\mathbf{20.09}$~N, corresponding to a $\mathbf{36.3\%}$ reduction. These results demonstrate the potential of ultrasound images as direct contact feedback for safe and accurate robot-assisted ultrasound imaging.

摘要（中文）：安全机器人辅助超声成像需要一种可靠的控制器，能够检测并定位探头与组织之间的相互作用。本文提出了一种基于B型超声图像的接触感知方法，以及一种面向机器人超声成像的接触感知阻抗控制器。该方法在不依赖力测量的情况下检测声学接触，从而实现基于接触状态的力/力矩置零，以减少残余 wrench 偏差。在接触过程中，该方法沿弯曲探头表面连续估计有效接触位置，并利用该位置更新控制器的交互坐标系，从而在成像过程中实现对物理探头-组织接触点的视觉伺服控制。在琼脂体模上的实验表明，在探头滚转角从$-15^\circ$到$15^\circ$的范围内，接触定位的均方根误差为$\mathbf{1.46 \pm 0.14}$~mm。在静态滚动过程中，所提出的控制器在保持任务空间跟踪精度与传统固定坐标系阻抗控制器相当的同时，将最大压缩交互力从$\mathbf{31.56}$~N降低至$\mathbf{20.09}$~N，降幅达$\mathbf{36.3\%}$。上述结果表明，超声图像作为直接接触反馈在安全、准确的机器人辅助超声成像中具有应用潜力。

Authors: MD Miraj Arefin, M Efe Tiryaki

Bayesian Active Learning for Intent Disambiguation in Interactive Robot Planning Other

interactive robot planning active learning intent disambiguation Signal Temporal Logic large language models

简要说明：该论文提出一种贝叶斯主动学习框架，在交互式机器人规划中通过将模糊的自然语言指令落地为信号时态逻辑规范来澄清意图，利用LLM生成候选规范和澄清问题，并采用贝叶斯优化选择信息增益最大的查询。在仿真和真实机器人上，该方法比LLM基线实现了更高的任务满意度且所需的澄清轮次更少。

TLDR: This paper presents a Bayesian active learning framework for clarifying ambiguous natural language instructions in interactive robot planning by grounding them as Signal Temporal Logic specifications, using LLMs to generate candidate specifications and clarification questions while Bayesian optimization selects queries maximizing information gain. The method achieves higher task satisfaction with fewer clarification rounds than LLM baselines across simulations and real robots.

Abstract: Interactive robot planning requires robots to infer and execute human intentions from natural language instructions that are often ambiguous, incomplete, or underspecified. Although large language models (LLMs) provide a powerful interface for clarification, relying on the generative model to drive an multi-turn conversation can introduce systematic failures. We propose a Bayesian framework that treats clarification as an active learning problem over grounded Signal Temporal Logic (STL) task specifications. Our method uses LLMs to initialize candidate formal specifications and translate informative contrasts into natural-language clarification questions, while Bayesian optimization maintains uncertainty estimation over user intent and selects queries that maximize information gain. After convergence, the inferred STL specification is passed to a formal planner to synthesize a verifiable robot trajectory. Across four simulated and real-world task domains, our approach generally achieves higher task satisfaction and requires fewer clarification rounds than LLM baselines, while helping smaller models close the performance gap against larger reasoning models.

摘要（中文）：交互式机器人规划要求机器人能够从自然语言指令中推断并执行人类意图，而这类指令往往存在歧义、信息不完整或表述不明确的问题。尽管大语言模型（LLM）为澄清机制提供了强大的交互接口，但依赖生成模型驱动多轮对话可能引入系统性失效。我们提出一种贝叶斯框架，将澄清问题视为基于语义信号时序逻辑（STL）任务规范上的主动学习问题。该方法利用大语言模型初始化候选形式化规范，并将信息性对比转换为自然语言澄清问题；同时，贝叶斯优化持续维护对用户意图的不确定性估计，并选择信息增益最大的查询进行提问。收敛后，推断所得的STL规范被传递给形式化规划器，以合成可验证的机器人轨迹。在四个仿真及真实世界任务领域中，与基于大语言模型的基线方法相比，我们的方法通常能够实现更高的任务满意度，并减少澄清轮次，同时帮助较小模型缩小与更大推理模型之间的性能差距。

Authors: Huao Li, Carson Sobolewski, Augustinos Saravanos, William Tan, John Karigiannis, Chuchu Fan

SAGE: Symbolic Action-Gating and Editing for LLM Task Planners Other

symbolic gate task planning LLM planner AI2-THOR embodied household agents

简要说明：SAGE 为具身家庭智能体的 LLM 任务规划器引入了轻量级符号门控和局部计划编辑，在 AI2-THOR 基准测试中提高了安全性和效率。

TLDR: SAGE introduces a lightweight symbolic gate and local plan editing for LLM-based task planners in embodied household agents, improving safety and efficiency in AI2-THOR benchmarks.

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are now the default cognitive core of embodied household agents, yet the plans they emit are rarely checked against a grounded model of the environment before execution, and the task-success they report is often measured on benchmarks so saturated that no method can be separated from another. We present SAGE (Symbolic Action-Gating and Editing), a single-LLM planner built from two lightweight mechanisms: a domain-agnostic symbolic gate (~250 lines of Python, zero tokens, $O(|π|)$) that blocks precondition-violating actions with typed reasons as a runtime safety monitor, and a local edit that regenerates only the failed sub-goal's suffix, keeping completed and untouched work intact; a hybrid seed+live memory store supports cold-start coverage. We evaluate under a leak-free protocol (leave-one-out retrieval) over five open-weight models and a 75-task AI2-THOR benchmark. On the standard benchmark goal-completeness saturates (52% of instances trivially solved) and SAGE ties strong hierarchical baselines. On a harder, method-agnostic multi-goal composition, SAGE's completeness lead re-emerges large (+0.06 to +0.23 across four models). Under injected mid-execution failures, SAGE recovers as reliably as whole-plan replanners at 2.4-3.3x fewer LLM calls. As a verify-before-execute gate, the symbolic monitor blocks unsafe actions before actuation and raises simulator-reported step-success for every planner tested (up to +0.11), a signal the verifier never sees (non-circular). Because the gate calls no model (0.008 ms/plan), it is a safety layer that runs essentially free on the edge: SAGE planning reproduces its quality on a Jetson AGX Orin, where small-model verification helps most. We release the benchmark, the leak-free protocol, the recovery and safety-gate harnesses, and a verifier-portability study (auto-induced on ALFWorld, 0.89 held-out).

摘要（中文）：大型语言模型（LLM）现已成为具身家庭智能体的默认认知核心，然而它们在执行前很少依据环境接地模型对其生成的计划进行校验，且其报告的任务成功率往往在高度饱和的基准上测量，以至于任何方法之间都无法区分。我们提出SAGE（符号动作门控与编辑，Symbolic Action-Gating and Editing），这是一种基于单一LLM的规划器，由两个轻量级机制构成：一个领域无关的符号门控（约250行Python代码，零token开销，复杂度为$O(|π|)$），作为运行时安全监控器，以类型化原因阻止违反前置条件的动作；以及一种局部编辑机制，仅重新生成失败子目标的后缀，保持已完成和未受影响的工作不变；同时，混合种子+实时记忆存储支持冷启动覆盖。我们在无泄漏协议（留一检索）下，对五个开放权重模型和一个包含75个任务的AI2-THOR基准进行了评估。在标准基准上，目标完成率已饱和（52%的实例可平凡求解），SAGE与强分层基线持平。在更困难、方法无关的多目标组合任务上，SAGE的完成率优势重新显著显现（四个模型上提升+0.06至+0.23）。在注入的中途执行失败场景下，SAGE以2.4至3.3倍更少的LLM调用次数达到与全计划重规划器相当的恢复可靠性。作为执行前验证门控，符号监控器在执行前阻止不安全动作，并提升了所有被测规划器的模拟器报告步级成功率（最高+0.11），而验证器从未见过该信号（非循环）。由于门控不调用模型（0.008毫秒/计划），它本质上是一种在边缘端几乎零成本运行的安全层：SAGE规划在Jetson AGX Orin上复现了同等质量，而小型模型验证在此场景中带来的帮助最大。我们发布了该基准、无泄漏协议、恢复与安全门控测试框架，以及验证器可移植性研究（在ALFWorld上自动诱导，保留集上达到0.89）。

Authors: Trung Minh Bui, JongSul Moon, YoungOuk Kim, Quang-Ngoc Phung, Se-Woong Jun, Dongin Shin

RLE-Bench: A Qualifying Exam for Coding Agents as Robot Learning Engineers Other

coding agents robot learning benchmark interactive control policy learning mechanical design

简要说明：RLE-Bench 是一个基准，用于评估编码代理在机器人学习工程任务中的表现，涵盖交互控制、策略学习、感知和机械设计，并将指标汇总为 RLE 指数。

TLDR: RLE-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on robot learning engineering tasks, covering interactive control, policy learning, perception, and mechanical design, aggregating metrics into an RLE Index.

Abstract: Coding agents are beginning to move beyond purely digital tasks to tackle physical-world challenges, particularly in robotics. Existing robotics benchmarks, however, primarily focus on the performance of individual artifacts, such as policies or controllers, offering limited coverage of coding agents' broader engineering capabilities. Real-world robotics extends beyond control: agents must build, integrate, diagnose, and improve heterogeneous artifacts under resource constraints and reason from multimodal feedback. To evaluate these broader capabilities, we introduce RLE-Bench, a benchmark of robot-learning tasks spanning four representative robotics development workflows: interactive control, policy learning, perception and estimation, and mechanical design. We use diverse task-specific metrics to evaluate the artifacts submitted by the coding agents, from the success rate the agents achieved to the policy agents trained, the harness agent built, and the mechanical structures the agent designed. We aggregate these metrics into an overall RLE Index and report workflow-specific capability profiles, enabling systematic comparison of coding agents' capabilities across multiple capability dimensions. Beyond performance ranks, we also conduct in-depth case studies examining agent behavior on representative tasks, highlighting both current capabilities and limitations, and pointing to the opportunities robotics tasks have to offer for future agent training.

摘要（中文）：编码代理正开始超越纯数字任务，涉足物理世界的挑战，尤其是在机器人领域。然而，现有的机器人基准主要聚焦于单个制品（如策略或控制器）的性能表现，对编码代理更广泛的工程能力的覆盖十分有限。现实世界的机器人技术远不止控制层面：代理必须在资源约束下构建、集成、诊断并改进异构制品，同时还要基于多模态反馈进行推理。为评估这些更广泛的能力，我们提出了RLE-Bench，一个涵盖四类代表性机器人开发工作流的机器人学习任务基准：交互控制、策略学习、感知与估计，以及机械设计。我们采用多样化的任务专属指标来评估编码代理提交的制品，涵盖代理实现的成功率、其训练出的策略代理、其构建的测试框架代理，以及其设计的机械结构。我们将这些指标聚合为一个综合的RLE指数，并输出各工作流的能力画像，从而支持在多个能力维度上对编码代理进行系统比较。除性能排名外，我们还开展了深入的案例研究，考察代理在代表性任务中的行为，既突出其当前能力，也揭示其局限性，并指明机器人任务为未来代理训练所提供的机遇。

Authors: Haitong Ma, Chenxiao Gao, Rushi Qiang, Bo Dai, Na Li

AGILE-GS: Anchor-Guided Fast Next-Best-View Selection for Active 3D Gaussian Splatting Perception3D

Next-Best-View 3D Gaussian Splatting Active Perception View Planning Information Gain

简要说明：AGILE-GS提出了一种基于锚点引导的3D高斯溅射下一最佳视角选择方法，将寻找信息量最大的相机位姿与候选排序分离，在离线及闭环具身采集场景中大幅提升选择速度，同时保持或提升重建质量。

TLDR: AGILE-GS introduces an anchor-guided next-best-view selection method for 3D Gaussian Splatting that separates the search for maximally informative camera poses from candidate ranking, achieving large speedups in selection latency while matching or improving reconstruction quality in both offline and closed-loop embodied acquisition settings.

Abstract: Radiance fields need hundreds of views, and their placement matters as much as their number. Next-best-view (NBV) selection for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) usually scores every candidate in the pool and keeps one. Searching for information and choosing a camera, however, are separable problems. We present AGILE-GS, an anchor-guided NBV method that separates the two. A virtual anchor pose is optimized on SE(3) by Riemannian gradient ascent on expected information gain. It need not be reachable or in the pool; it marks where the model is most uncertain. Candidates are scored against the anchor's viewing geometry, and a greedy ridge-leverage step distills the pool into a small, non-redundant shortlist without rendering any candidate. The shortlist can be used in two ways. AGILE-GS takes the first view on it as the next view, so no Fisher information is computed for any candidate. AGILE-GS+ computes the Fisher information gain of each shortlisted view and picks the best, so the expensive evaluation runs on a handful of views rather than the whole pool. On standard benchmarks and in closed-loop embodied acquisition, both match or exceed existing baselines while cutting selection latency by one to two orders of magnitude.

摘要（中文）：辐射场需要数百个视角，且视角的位置与数量同等重要。针对三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）的下一最佳视角（NBV）选择方法通常会对候选集中的每个视角进行评分，并保留得分最高的一个。然而，信息搜索与相机选择是两个可分离的问题。我们提出AGILE-GS，一种锚点引导的NBV方法，将这两个问题分离开来。一个虚拟锚点姿态通过黎曼梯度上升法在SE(3)空间中基于期望信息增益进行优化。该锚点姿态无需可达，也无需存在于候选集中；它标记了模型不确定性最大的位置。候选视角根据锚点的观测几何进行评分，并通过贪心岭杠杆步骤将候选集精简为一个小型且无冗余的候选短名单，无需渲染任何候选视角。该短名单可有两种使用方式。AGILE-GS将短名单中的第一个视角作为下一视角，因此无需为任何候选视角计算Fisher信息。AGILE-GS+则计算短名单中每个视角的Fisher信息增益并选择最优者，从而使昂贵的评估仅运行在少数几个视角上，而非整个候选集。在标准基准测试和闭环具身体验采集中，两种方法均达到或超越现有基线，同时将选择延迟降低一至两个数量级。

Authors: Amirhossein Mollaei Khass, Nader Motee

Embodied Semantic Communication for Collective Autonomous Agents: A Tutorial on Representation, Wireless Delivery, and Closed-Loop Coordination Other

embodied semantic communication multi-agent coordination world models action-oriented representation wireless delivery

简要说明：本文提出具身语义通信（ESC），一种面向多智能体自主系统的通信范式，通过传输包含多模态感知、硬件能力和意图的行动导向语义表示来实现协调控制，并梳理了相关数学工具与开放挑战。

TLDR: This paper introduces embodied semantic communication (ESC), a paradigm for multi-agent autonomous systems that transmits action-oriented semantic representations—encapsulating multimodal perception, hardware capabilities, and intents—to enable coordinated motor control, and maps underlying mathematical tools and open challenges.

Abstract: As autonomous systems and embodied intelligence enter the dynamic physical world, multi-agent collaboration calls for a paradigm shift in communication design. However, existing communication paradigms overlook that agents form action understanding from their own states, environmental observations, and collaboration relations through a process that evolves as a task unfolds. Consequently, reliable bit delivery, general semantic recovery, or single-task utility optimization alone cannot ensure that heterogeneous agents form coordinated actions compatible with their own conditions from shared information during task execution. To address this gap, this paper proposes embodied semantic communication (ESC) as a paradigm that transforms information transmission into action-oriented semantic interaction. Specifically, ESC characterizes how an explicit communication link can encapsulate multimodal perceptual states, intrinsic hardware capabilities, and collaborative intents into unified actionable semantic representations, thereby enabling heterogeneous receiving agents to parse, align, and ground them in local motor control. This paper clarifies the conceptual boundary, system characteristics, and environment-constrained technical pathways of ESC. It maps the underlying mathematical tools, including semantic information theory, world models, and multi-agent decision theory. Finally, this paper summarizes key open challenges, including measurable semantic reliability, ambiguity-triggered interaction under dynamic environments and tasks, and bandwidth-adaptive semantic transmission, outlining a roadmap for collective embodied networks.

摘要（中文）：随着自主系统与具身智能进入动态物理世界，多智能体协作呼唤通信设计的范式转换。然而，现有通信范式忽视了智能体在任务展开过程中，通过自身状态、环境观测和协作关系逐步演化形成动作理解这一事实。因此，仅靠可靠的比特传输、通用的语义恢复或单一任务效用优化，无法确保异构智能体在执行任务时能够从共享信息中形成与其自身条件相协调的动作行为。为弥补这一缺口，本文提出具身语义通信（ESC）范式，将信息传输转变为面向动作的语义交互。具体而言，ESC刻画了显式通信链路如何将多模态感知状态、内在硬件能力及协作意图封装为统一的可行动语义表征，从而使异构接收智能体能够在局部运动控制中对其进行解析、对齐和落地。本文阐明了ESC的概念边界、系统特征及环境约束下的技术路径，梳理了包括语义信息论、世界模型和多智能体决策理论在内的底层数学工具。最后，本文总结了关键开放挑战，包括可度量的语义可靠性、动态环境与任务下歧义触发的交互，以及带宽自适应的语义传输，勾勒了协同具身网络的发展路线图。

Authors: Yizheng Huang, Wensheng Lin, Lixin Li, Qinghe Du, Wenchi Cheng, Zhu Han

Learning What to Recall: Adaptive Multi-Cue Episodic Memory for World Models WorldModel

episodic memory world models future-aware recall multi-cue scoring adaptive retrieval

简要说明：FAR通过利用未来感知的预测监督和自适应多线索评分来训练检索器，为世界模型检索情节记忆，从而在各种设置中改善预测。

TLDR: FAR learns to retrieve episodic memories for world models by training a retriever with future-aware predictive supervision and adaptive multi-cue scoring, improving prediction in diverse settings.

Abstract: World models predict future observations from current experience and actions, yet prediction can depend on observations seen far in the past. Episodic memory preserves past observations for later recall; however, as memory accumulates, it raises a fundamental question: which memories are useful for the current prediction, and which available retrieval cues should be trusted to find them? This is challenging because fixed criteria based on recency, pose overlap, or visual similarity can be unreliable across environments and queries. We propose Future-Aware Recall (FAR), a framework that learns episodic recall from future-aware predictive supervision and adaptive multi-cue scoring. During training, FAR measures predictive utility by the conditional log-likelihood of the realized future given recalled context, approximated by negative diffusion prediction loss, and uses it to train a retriever that remains future-blind at inference. The retriever learns cue-specific relevance and automatically determines which available retrieval cues, such as time, pose, vision, and audio, to trust for each query when selecting memories. Across three complementary settings, FAR outperforms hand-designed recall even with the same retrieval cues, automatically adapts which available cues to trust, and recalls the right history as the world changes. Together, these results establish FAR as a flexible, principled approach to episodic memory access in world models.

摘要（中文）：世界模型根据当前的体验和动作预测未来的观测，然而预测可能依赖于久远过去的观测。情景记忆保存过去的观测以备后续回忆；但随着记忆的累积，一个根本性问题随之产生：哪些记忆对当前预测有用，以及应当信任哪些可用的检索线索来找到这些记忆？这一问题颇具挑战性，因为基于近因性、位姿重合度或视觉相似性的固定标准在不同环境和查询条件下可能并不可靠。我们提出未来感知回忆（FAR），一个通过未来感知预测监督和自适应多线索评分来学习情景回忆的框架。在训练阶段，FAR通过给定回忆上下文条件下已实现未来的条件对数似然来衡量预测效用，该似然以负扩散预测损失近似，并利用其训练一个在推理时对未来保持盲态的检索器。该检索器学习线索特定的相关性，并在选择记忆时自动判定每个查询应信任哪些可用的检索线索，如时间、位姿、视觉和音频。在三个互补的实验设置中，即便使用相同的检索线索，FAR也优于人工设计的回忆策略，能够自动适应性地信任可用的线索，并在世界变化时回忆正确历史。综合而言，这些结果确立了FAR作为世界模型中情景记忆访问的一种灵活且原理性方法的地位。

Authors: Beomsu Kim, Chieh-Hsin Lai, Bac Nguyen, Amir Bar, Jong Chul Ye, Yuki Mitsufuji

WorldPlay2: Extending Real-Time Interactive World Models in Control and Horizon WorldModel

interactive world model factorized hybrid control compressed memory stable distillation long-horizon consistency

简要说明：WorldPlay2 提出了因子化混合控制接口以及压缩记忆与稳定蒸馏的协同设计，实现了实时、长时程的交互式世界建模，并在泛化性和性能上优于现有方法。

TLDR: WorldPlay2 introduces a factorized hybrid control interface and a co-designed compressed memory with stable distillation to enable real-time, long-horizon interactive world modeling, demonstrating superior generalizability and performance.

Abstract: Interactive world models require responding in real time to versatile controls and maintaining long-horizon consistency. However, modeling heterogeneous controls remains difficult, while explosive contexts and unstable distillation impede achieving both long-horizon consistency and real-time responsiveness. In this paper, we present WorldPlay2, an interactive world model that couples a factorized hybrid control interface with a co-design of compressed memory and stable distillation. 1) Our factorized hybrid control interface integrates frame-aligned action control with structured semantic control that explicitly disentangles scene appearance, character identity, and dynamic semantic events, thereby facilitating effective control learning. 2) To achieve efficient long-horizon modeling, we compress historical contexts into compact memory tokens shared by the autoregressive student and the bidirectional teacher. This design enables clip-wise, memory-conditioned score evaluation instead of jointly processing an entire long rollout, substantially reducing distillation overhead. 3) We further propose Stable Forcing, which initializes the autoregressive student via a few-step strategy and leverages full-rollout replay to preserve the quality of long-horizon rollouts, ensuring robust and stable distillation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the strong generalizability of our model and its superior performance compared to existing methods.

摘要（中文）：交互式世界模型需要实时响应多样化的控制指令，同时保持长时间范围的一致性。然而，对异构控制进行建模仍然十分困难，同时爆炸性的上下文和不稳定的蒸馏过程阻碍了在长时间一致性与实时响应性之间取得平衡。本文提出WorldPlay2，一种交互式世界模型，将分解式混合控制接口与压缩记忆和稳定蒸馏的协同设计相结合。1) 我们提出的分解式混合控制接口将帧对齐的动作控制与结构化语义控制相结合，显式区分场景外观、角色身份和动态语义事件，从而促进有效的控制学习。2) 为实现高效的长时间范围建模，我们将历史上下文压缩为紧凑的记忆标记，由自回归学生模型和双向教师模型共享。该设计支持以片段为单位、基于记忆条件的分数评估，而非对完整长序列进行联合处理，从而大幅降低蒸馏开销。3) 我们进一步提出稳定强制策略，通过少步策略初始化自回归学生模型，并利用完整序列回放来保持长序列生成质量，确保蒸馏过程的稳健性和稳定性。大量实验证明，该模型具有很强的泛化能力，且性能优于现有方法。

Authors: Haiyu Zhang, Wenqiang Sun, Tengfei Wang, Junta Wu, Jun Zhang, Yunhong Wang, Yu Qiao, Chunchao Guo

WorldAttention: An Efficient Attention Architecture for Interactive Video World Models WorldModel

Hybrid Sparse Attention Hierarchical KV Cache Interactive Video World Models Autoregressive Diffusion Attention Kernels

简要说明：WorldAttention 提出了一种用于交互式视频世界模型的高效注意力架构，通过混合稀疏注意力和分层 KV 缓存管理来降低计算和内存成本，同时保留长程上下文，在 VBench-Long 和 InterVBench 上取得了优越性能。

TLDR: WorldAttention proposes an efficient attention architecture for interactive video world models, combining Hybrid Sparse Attention and Hierarchical KV Cache management to reduce computational and memory costs while preserving long-range context, achieving superior performance on VBench-Long and InterVBench.

Abstract: Leveraging the paradigm of autoregressive diffusion, text-conditioned interactive video world models aim to simulate temporally coherent environments guided by textual instructions. While enabling low-latency, long-duration generation is pivotal for embodied AI and simulation-based planning, current frameworks primarily rely on sliding-window mechanisms to bound computational complexity. However, this approach inherently sacrifices historical context, undermining the long-range interactive capabilities. Conversely, maintaining a full-history cache remains computationally prohibitive and memory-intensive: the quadratic complexity of attention leads to excessive computational overhead, while the linear growth of the KV cache inevitably leads to GPU memory saturation. To overcome these limitations, we propose WorldAttention, a system-oriented attention architecture that achieves high efficiency through the co-design of specialized attention kernels and hierarchical KV cache management. First, we introduce Hybrid Sparse Attention (HSA), which integrates linear global attention supplemented with head-adaptive sparse attention. Additionally, we design a Hierarchical KV Cache (HKV) that organizes historical KV pairs into semantically indexed pages across multi-tier memory, enabling fine-grained retrieval and controlled GPU residency. These two designs are supported by tailored kernels to effectively translate their theoretical efficiency into real-world performance. Extensive experiments on VBench-Long and InterVBench demonstrate that WorldAttention consistently surpasses prior state-of-the-art methods, achieving subject consistency scores of 0.9472 on VBench-Long and 0.9668 on InterVBench, respectively.

摘要（中文）：利用自回归扩散范式，文本条件驱动的交互式视频世界模型旨在模拟由文本指令引导的时序一致环境。尽管实现低延迟、长时程生成对于具身智能和基于仿真的规划至关重要，但现有框架主要依赖滑动窗口机制来限制计算复杂度。然而，这种方法本质上会牺牲历史上下文信息，削弱长程交互能力。相反，保留完整历史缓存的计算开销和内存占用则难以承受：注意力机制的二次复杂度导致计算开销过大，而KV缓存的线性增长不可避免地导致GPU内存饱和。为克服上述限制，我们提出WorldAttention——一种面向系统的注意力架构，通过专用注意力内核与分层KV缓存管理的协同设计实现高效性能。首先，我们引入混合稀疏注意力（HSA），将线性全局注意力与头自适应稀疏注意力相结合。此外，我们设计了分层KV缓存（HKV），将历史KV对按语义索引组织到跨多层内存的页面中，实现细粒度检索和受控的GPU驻留。这两种设计均配备定制内核，以将理论效率有效转化为实际性能。在VBench-Long和InterVBench上的大量实验表明，WorldAttention持续超越现有最先进方法，在VBench-Long上取得0.9472的主体一致性得分，在InterVBench上取得0.9668的主体一致性得分。

Authors: Zeyu Zhang, Jinyuan Mao, Dakai An, Wangbo Zhao, Hanfeng Lu, Jiasheng Tang, Yinghao Yu, Wei Wang, Bohan Zhuang

Control-Geometry Straightening for Sampling-Based Latent Planning WorldModel

latent world models sampling-based planning representation learning auxiliary loss MPPI

简要说明：本文提出了控制几何拉直（CGS），一种学习有利于采样的规划器友好潜在表示的辅助损失，在多个控制环境和规划器中提高了成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces Control-Geometry Straightening (CGS), an auxiliary loss that learns planner-friendly latent representations for sampling-based planning, improving success rates across multiple control environments and planners.

Abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures enable planning with latent world models, but accurate transition prediction alone does not ensure that the planning objective is easy to optimize. We introduce Control-Geometry Straightening (CGS), a single auxiliary loss that learns planner-friendly representations by directly straightening control geometry for sampling-efficient planning. CGS matches pairwise cosine similarities among actions to those among corresponding latent differences only using local transitions from pixel-action pairs. The loss can be applied across world-model architectures using end-to-end learned or pretrained representations. Under linear-dynamics, our theoretical analysis connects this objective to temporal straightening and more balanced terminal-cost curvature across the full planning horizon, yielding finite-budget guarantees for MPPI, local contraction results for CEM, and convergence bounds for gradient descent. Across four control environments and multiple planners, CGS improves planning with fewer sampled candidates and refinement steps, achieving success-rate gains up to 20 and 12.6 percentage points over LeWorldModel (LeWM) and its temporal-straightening variant (LeWM+TS), respectively, with sampling-based planners using 128 candidates per update. Probes, comparisons with DINO-WM architecture, and planner-side ablations clarify how latent motion organization, state dependence, and dynamical context shape planning behavior. Straightening control geometry thus makes good action sequences easier to find under limited planning budgets.

摘要（中文）：联合嵌入预测架构使得利用潜在世界模型进行规划成为可能，但仅凭准确的转移预测并不能确保规划目标易于优化。我们引入了控制几何拉直（CGS），这是一种单一的辅助损失，通过直接拉直控制几何来实现采样高效的规划，从而学习适合规划器的表示。CGS仅利用像素-动作对的局部转移，将动作之间的成对余弦相似性与相应潜在差异之间的成对余弦相似性进行匹配。该损失可应用于使用端到端学习或预训练表示的世界模型架构。在线性动力学条件下，我们的理论分析将该目标与时间拉直以及全规划范围内更均衡的终端代价曲率联系起来，为MPPI提供了有限预算保证，为CEM提供了局部收缩结果，并为梯度下降提供了收敛界限。在四个控制环境和多种规划器中，CGS以更少的采样候选和细化步骤改善了规划性能，在使用每次更新128个候选的基于采样的规划器时，相较于LeWorldModel（LeWM）及其时间拉直变体（LeWM+TS），成功率分别提升了高达20和12.6个百分点。探针实验、与DINO-WM架构的比较以及规划器侧的消融研究阐明了潜在运动组织、状态依赖性和动力学背景如何塑造规划行为。因此，拉直控制几何使得在有限的规划预算下更容易找到良好的动作序列。

Authors: Ziang Fu, Ning Ning

Shaping Persistent Representations from Independent Interactions WorldModel

persistent representation world models weak supervision interaction relations robotic data

简要说明：SPRII 提出一种训练原则，利用交互之间的关系作为弱监督来塑造世界模型中的持久表示，在包括机器人和触觉数据在内的多种设置中提升了下游任务性能和属性读取。

TLDR: SPRII introduces a training principle that uses relations between interactions as weak supervision to shape persistent representations in world models, improving downstream task performance and property readout across diverse settings including robotic and tactile data.

Abstract: World models learn environment dynamics from interaction experience. These dynamics depend on the current state and actions, as well as on properties that persist across interactions. Yet standard predictive training can reduce error using local evidence alone, without organizing persistent information into reusable context. We introduce SPRII, a training principle that uses relations between interactions as weak supervision for persistent context while retaining the learner's native objective. For example, different trajectories of the same system share persistent properties even when their states and actions differ. SPRII uses such relations to guide context learning without numerical property labels. Two composable components encourage contexts from related interactions to agree (Align) and use one interaction's context to predict another's future (Cross). Our analysis distinguishes three linked questions: what persistent information is accessible in the learned context (Formation), how that context influences a fixed predictor (Use), and whether it reduces task error (Value). Success at one stage does not guarantee success at the next. Controlled experiments show that more reliable relations improve representation organization, but adding a shared-property constraint can reduce access to a property that remains shared. Context substitutions change predictions at fixed model weights, while the benefit from history depends on prediction horizon and readout. Evaluations span thirteen settings, including controlled physical systems, public dynamics tasks, robotic and tactile data, and partner interaction, across multiple learner families. Relative to the corresponding baselines, SPRII yields average gains of over 10% in downstream task performance and over 15% in persistent-property readout. The project page is available at https://persistent-learning-review.netlify.app/interactive.html.

摘要（中文）：世界模型从交互经验中学习环境动态。这些动态既取决于当前状态和动作，也取决于在多次交互中持续存在的属性。然而，标准的预测训练可以仅利用局部证据来减少误差，而无需将持久信息组织为可复用的上下文。我们提出SPRII，这是一种训练原则，利用交互之间的关系作为持久上下文的弱监督，同时保留学习器自身的原生目标。例如，同一系统的不同轨迹即使状态和动作不同，也共享持久属性。SPRII利用此类关系引导上下文学习，而无需数值属性标签。两个可组合的组件促使来自相关交互的上下文趋于一致（对齐），并利用一个交互的上下文预测另一个交互的未来（交叉）。我们的分析区分了三个相互关联的问题：学习到的上下文中可访问哪些持久信息（形成），该上下文如何影响固定预测器（使用），以及它是否能降低任务误差（价值）。某一阶段的成功并不能保证下一阶段的成功。受控实验表明，更可靠的关系能改善表征组织，但添加共享属性约束可能会降低对仍然共享的属性的可访问性。上下文替换会在固定模型权重下改变预测结果，而历史信息的收益取决于预测时域和读出方式。评估涵盖十三个设置，包括受控物理系统、公开动态任务、机器人与触觉数据以及伙伴交互，涉及多种学习器家族。与相应基线相比，SPRII在下游任务性能上平均提升超过10%，在持久属性读出上平均提升超过15%。项目页面位于https://persistent-learning-review.netlify.app/interactive.html。

Authors: Ji Dai, Quan Fang, Junyu Gao, Rongfeng Guo, Haoyan Rong, YipingHuang, Yongxi Li

Behavioral Monitoring of JEPA World Models with Jacobian Centroids WorldModel

JEPA World Model Jacobian Centroids Planning Failure Detection Distribution Shift

简要说明：本文提出了雅可比质心方法，用于监控JEPA世界模型在连续控制任务中的行为对齐性，从而在动作执行前检测规划失败并改进分布偏移检测。

TLDR: This paper introduces Jacobian centroids, a method for monitoring the behavioral alignment of JEPA world models in continuous control tasks, enabling detection of planning failures before actions are executed and improving distribution-shift detection.

Abstract: Detecting failures in World Model (WM)-based planning requires monitoring whether the model is behaviorally aligned with the current task, which in turn requires studying its internal representations. Here, we show that centroids---sub-component Jacobian row-sums---effectively identify the behavioral properties of WMs, complementing traditional activation-based knowledge signals. The centroids of a model are easily computed through Jacobian vector products and characterize how the model organizes the geometry of its input space, yielding an efficient perspective on internal representations, including the generation of task-relevant saliency maps. Evaluated on continuous control tasks using JEPA WMs, this behavioral view reveals a structural dissociation, where the encoder correctly represents the goal while the predictor remains behaviorally unresponsive. This failure mode directly predicts planning failure before any action is taken, allowing for goal resampling to recapture out-of-distribution success. Moreover, centroid-based methods outperform baseline methods as distribution-shift detectors. Together, these tools yield a behavioral monitoring stack that is operational and consequential under distribution shifts.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 在基于世界模型（WM）的规划中检测故障，需要监测模型是否与当前任务在行为上保持一致，这进而要求研究其内部表示。本文表明，质心——子组件雅可比行和——能够有效识别世界模型的行为属性，补充了传统的基于激活的知识信号。模型的质心可通过雅可比向量积简便计算，并能刻画模型如何组织其输入空间的几何结构，从而提供一种高效的内部表示视角，包括生成任务相关的显著性图。在使用JEPA世界模型进行的连续控制任务评估中，这种行为视角揭示了一种结构性分离：编码器正确地表征目标，而预测器则在行为上无响应。这种失效模式可直接在采取任何行动之前预测规划的失败，从而允许通过目标重采样来重新捕获分布外成功。此外，基于质心的方法在分布偏移检测方面优于基线方法。综合来看，这些工具构成了一套在分布偏移下具有可操作性和实际效用的行为监测体系。

Authors: Thomas Walker, Randall Balestriero, Richard Baraniuk

RoboCompiler: Graph-Native Compilation of Closed-Chain Robots for Consistent Modeling, Control, and Simulation Locomotion

closed-chain robots kinematic loops mechanism graph rigid-body dynamics simulation

简要说明：RoboCompiler 是一个图原生框架，将闭链机器人机构编译为共享机械接口，确保在不同机器人和仿真器中建模、控制和仿真的一致性。

TLDR: RoboCompiler is a graph-native framework for compiling closed-chain robot mechanisms into shared mechanical interfaces, ensuring consistent modeling, control, and simulation across different robots and simulators.

Abstract: Robots with kinematic loops, coupled actuators, and changing contacts require consistent models of configuration, motion, force, and dynamics. Yet these interfaces are often reconstructed separately for control and simulation, making closure and actuation consistency difficult to maintain. This paper presents RoboCompiler, a graph-native framework that compiles a canonical mechanism graph into a shared mechanical interface. From bodies, joints, frames, inertias, and actuator ports, it constructs closure paths and analytic residual Jacobians, then assembles feasible configurations through rank-checked continuation and correction. A tangent lift maps independent velocities to full robot and task motion, while paired actuator-port maps preserve virtual work. A constraint-curvature correction extends the reduction to accelerations and projected rigid-body dynamics, including floating-base and support modes. Cycle-local evaluation, generated Jacobians, and dependency-aware reuse enable localized updates when closure inputs change. We evaluate physical loops and task-induced constraints on a industrial excavator, Unitree Go2, Franka Panda, Kangaroo, and a six-UPS Stewart platform. High-precision constrained-dynamics and independent Pinocchio checks confirm mechanical consistency; MuJoCo and Isaac Sim/PhysX executions demonstrate task performance and model reuse under native contact. For Kangaroo, compilation reduces residual-and-Jacobian evaluation time by 96.7% and closed-loop rollout wall time by 66.8%, with dynamics and control held fixed.

摘要（中文）：具有运动学闭环、耦合驱动和变接触状态的机器人，需要统一且一致的构型、运动、力与动力学模型。然而，这些接口在实际中往往分别为控制与仿真单独构建，导致闭环和驱动一致性难以维持。本文提出了RoboCompiler，一种图原生的框架，将规范的机构图编译为共享的机械接口。基于刚体、关节、坐标系、惯性参数和驱动器端口，该框架构造闭环路径并解析求解残差雅可比矩阵，进而通过带秩校验的延拓与修正过程组装可行构型。切向提升将独立速度映射至完整机器人与任务运动，同时配对驱动器端口映射保持虚功守恒。约束曲率修正将降维进一步扩展至加速度与投影刚体动力学，覆盖浮动基座与支撑模式。循环局部求值、生成的雅可比矩阵以及依赖感知的复用机制，使得闭环输入发生变化时能够进行局部更新。我们在工业挖掘机、Unitree Go2、Franka Panda、Kangaroo以及六-UPS Stewart平台上，对物理闭环和任务引入约束进行了评估。高精度约束动力学结果与独立的Pinocchio校验确认了机械一致性；MuJoCo和Isaac Sim/PhysX实验验证了原生接触下的任务性能与模型复用能力。以Kangaroo为例，编译使残差与雅可比矩阵求值时间减少96.7%，闭环滚动仿真墙钟时间减少66.8%，且动力学与控制部分保持不变。

Authors: Mehdi Heydari Shahna, Joongheon Kim, Jouni Mattila

Memory in the Sky: Low-Altitude Question Answering with Multi-Agent Memory Aggregation Other

low-altitude question answering multi-agent memory aggregation generative adversarial exam resource allocation UAV-to-robot-dog

简要说明：本文提出低空问答（LAQA）的多无人机内存聚合框架，利用生成对抗考试（GAE）评估内存价值，并在通信约束下进行内存为中心的功率分配，在CARLA仿真和真实实验中验证，包括无人机到机器狗导航。

TLDR: This paper introduces low-altitude question answering (LAQA) with a multi-UAV memory aggregation framework, featuring a generative adversarial exam (GAE) for memory valuation and a memory-centric resource allocation with water-filling power control, validated in CARLA simulations and real-world experiments including UAV-to-robot-dog navigation.

Abstract: This paper studies low-altitude question answering (LAQA), in which distributed unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) memories are aggregated at a ground server to answer questions about observations over a long horizon. Unlike conventional resource allocation based on sensing, communication, control, or computation metrics, LAQA requires an explicit measure of memory value. We propose a generative adversarial exam (GAE) that uses forward simulation to evaluate memory retrieval and exam scores to quantify memory quality. This enables the downstream QA value of candidate memories to be measured and optimized without accessing the internal mechanisms of the black-box captioning, retrieval, and reasoning pipeline. Building on this metric, we develop a memory-centric (MemCen) framework that jointly selects UAVs and allocates transmit power to maximize memory quality under communication constraints. In the noise-limited regime, we derive a QoM-aware capped water-filling law that explicitly connects task utility with physical-layer power allocation. We further develop penalty successive optimization (PSO) and learning to memorize (L2M) solvers. MemCen achieves QA accuracies of 92.4% and 84.0% in CARLA Town04 and Town05 under static and dynamic communication conditions, respectively. In real-world experiments, MemCen achieves 88.5% QA accuracy on the panoramic multi-agent system (PMAS) benchmark. Finally, UAV-to-robot-dog demonstrations further validate the practical utility of the acquired memories for environmental understanding and navigation.

摘要（中文）：本文研究了低空问答（LAQA）问题，其中分布式无人机（UAV）的记忆在地面服务器上进行聚合，以回答关于长时间跨度观测的问题。与基于感知、通信、控制或计算指标的传统资源分配不同，LAQA需要一种显式的记忆价值度量。我们提出了一种生成对抗考试（GAE）方法，利用前向仿真评估记忆检索，并通过考试成绩量化记忆质量。这使得在不访问黑盒字幕生成、检索和推理流水线内部机制的情况下，能够度量并优化候选记忆的下游问答价值。基于这一指标，我们开发了一种以记忆为中心（MemCen）的框架，该框架联合选择无人机并在通信约束下分配发射功率，以最大化记忆质量。在噪声受限条件下，我们推导出一种QoM感知的封顶注水法则，将任务效用与物理层功率分配显式关联。我们进一步开发了罚函数逐次优化（PSO）和记忆学习（L2M）求解器。在CARLA Town04和Town05场景中，MemCen在静态和动态通信条件下分别实现了92.4%和84.0%的问答准确率。在真实世界实验中，MemCen在全景多智能体系统（PMAS）基准上实现了88.5%的问答准确率。最后，无人机到机器狗（UAV-to-robot-dog）的演示进一步验证了所获取记忆在环境理解和导航中的实际效用。

Authors: Chengyang Li, Yujie Wan, Shuai Wang, Kejiang Ye, Weijie Yuan, Boyu Zhou, Yik-Chung Wu, Chengzhong Xu, Huseyin Arslan

Repair Before You Fuse: Frozen-Host Adaptation for Corrupted-but-Present Sensors Perception3D

camera-LiDAR detection corruption robustness frozen-host adaptation boundary feature repair KITTI-C

简要说明：本文提出了边界特征修复（BFR），一种冻结主干的适配框架，通过在模态接口学习残差修正，在不重新训练部署检测器的情况下提高相机-激光雷达3D目标检测器对损坏的鲁棒性。

TLDR: This paper introduces Boundary Feature Repair (BFR), a frozen-host adaptation framework that learns residual corrections at modality interfaces to improve the robustness of camera-LiDAR 3D object detectors against corruptions, without retraining the deployed detector.

Abstract: Camera-LiDAR detectors can continue to consume unreliable features even when both sensors remain present, synchronized, and calibrated. We introduce \emph{Boundary Feature Repair} (BFR), a frozen-host adaptation framework that learns task-supervised residual corrections at modality interfaces the detector already consumes. BFR-C repairs each camera feature level read by fusion, whereas BFR-L aligns host-conditioned LiDAR candidates to a selected boundary and routes site-wise innovations relative to the frozen anchor. Their jointly trained composition is BFR-CL. Zero-initialized per-channel scales make every variant an exact detector-level identity before optimization; only the repair modules train, while the encoders, fusion consumer, router, detection head, and host normalization statistics remain fixed. At inference, BFR requires neither clean references, corruption metadata, temporal history, nor online updates. Across the complete 20-corruption, five-severity KITTI-C grid, BFR-C reduces RCE from $14.07$ to $11.92$ on MVX-Net and from $14.29$ to $11.00$ on Focals Conv-F relative to their reproduced frozen baselines. On the latter host, BFR-L raises AP$_{\mathrm{cor}}$ from $73.65$ to $74.48$, while BFR-CL reaches $77.01$ AP$_{\mathrm{cor}}$ and $10.46$ RCE with $86.02$ clean AP. On nuScenes-R, BFR-CL raises the reproduced MoME baseline's mAP robustness ratio from $80.1$ to $81.4$. These results establish boundary repair as a targeted retrofit for corrupted-but-present sensing without retraining the deployed detector.

摘要（中文）：相机-激光雷达检测器即使在两种传感器均存在、同步且已标定的情况下，仍可能持续消耗不可靠的特征。我们提出**边界特征修复**（Boundary Feature Repair, BFR），一种冻结宿主适配框架，在检测器已消费的多模态接口处学习任务监督的残差校正。BFR-C修复融合模块读取的每个相机特征层级，而BFR-L将宿主条件下的激光雷达候选框对齐到选定边界，并相对于冻结锚点路由逐站点创新。二者联合训练的组合即为BFR-CL。零初始化的逐通道缩放使每种变体在优化前严格保持检测器级恒等映射；仅修复模块参与训练，编码器、融合消费模块、路由器、检测头及宿主归一化统计量均保持固定。推理时，BFR无需干净参考、退化元数据、时间历史或在线更新。在完整的20种退化、5级严重度的KITTI-C网格上，相对于复现的冻结基线，BFR-C将MVX-Net的RCE从$14.07$降至$11.92$，将Focals Conv-F的RCE从$14.29$降至$11.00$。在后一宿主机上，BFR-L将AP$_{\mathrm{cor}}$从$73.65$提升至$74.48$，而BFR-CL达到$77.01$ AP$_{\mathrm{cor}}$和$10.46$ RCE，同时保持$86.02$的干净AP。在nuScenes-R上，BFR-CL将复现的MoME基线的mAP鲁棒性比率从$80.1$提升至$81.4$。这些结果确立了边界修复作为一种针对“退化但存在”感知场景的定向改造方案，且无需重新训练已部署的检测器。
