Authors: Gia-Huy Thai, Quang-Thinh Ly, Anh-Minh Phan, Tuan Dang

Learning High-Risk High-Precision Motion Control RLRobot

advantage-weighted regression mixture-of-experts policy elite sample optimization high-precision motion control billiard shots

简要说明：本文提出SCOOT，一种面向高风险高精度运动控制的深度强化学习算法，通过精英样本策略优化、专家混合策略和距离正则化，学习物理台球击球动作。

TLDR: This paper introduces SCOOT, a DRL algorithm for high-risk high-precision motion control, using elite sample policy optimization, mixture-of-experts policy, and distance regularization to learn physically-based billiard shots.

Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algorithms for movement control are typically evaluated and benchmarked on sequential decision tasks where imprecise actions may be corrected with later actions, thus allowing high returns with noisy actions. In contrast, we focus on an under-researched class of high-risk, high-precision motion control problems where actions carry irreversible outcomes, driving sharp peaks and ridges to plague the state-action reward landscape. Using computational pool as a representative example of such problems, we propose and evaluate State-Conditioned Shooting (SCOOT), a novel DRL algorithm that builds on advantage-weighted regression (AWR) with three key modifications: 1) Performing policy optimization only using elite samples, allowing the policy to better latch on to the rare high-reward action samples; 2) Utilizing a mixture-of-experts (MoE) policy, to allow switching between reward landscape modes depending on the state; 3) Adding a distance regularization term and a learning curriculum to encourage exploring diverse strategies before adapting to the most advantageous samples. We showcase our features' performance in learning physically-based billiard shots demonstrating high action precision and discovering multiple shot strategies for a given ball configuration.

摘要（中文）：深度强化学习（DRL）算法在运动控制中的评估与基准测试通常基于序贯决策任务，在此类任务中，不精确的动作可通过后续动作加以修正，因此即便存在噪声动作，仍可获得较高回报。然而，本文关注一类研究较少的高风险、高精度运动控制问题，其动作具有不可逆的后果，导致状态-动作奖励景观中出现尖锐的峰值与脊线。以计算台球作为此类问题的典型代表，我们提出并评估了状态条件射击（SCOOT）算法，这是一种新颖的DRL算法，基于优势加权回归（AWR）并进行三项关键改进：1）仅使用精英样本进行策略优化，使策略能够更好地锁定稀有高奖励动作样本；2）采用专家混合（MoE）策略，以便根据状态在不同奖励景观模式之间切换；3）引入距离正则化项及学习课程，鼓励在适应最优样本之前探索多样化策略。我们展示了所提出特征在学习基于物理的台球击球中的性能，证明了其能够实现高动作精度，并在给定球布局下发现多种击球策略。

Authors: Nam Hee Kim, Markus Kirjonen, Perttu Hämäläinen

Simulation for Planetary Robotic Perception and Autonomy: A Concise Survey of Recent Capabilities and Gaps Other

planetary robotics simulation perception autonomy synthetic data

简要说明：本文综述了用于行星机器人感知与自主性的仿真工具与工作，从开放性、平台覆盖、传感器支持与真实性等维度进行分析，并指出了公开资源不均衡、运行约束建模不足等缺口。

TLDR: This paper surveys simulation tools and works for planetary robotic perception and autonomy, analyzing them across axes of openness, platform coverage, sensor support, and realism, and identifies gaps such as uneven availability and limited operational constraint modeling.

Abstract: Planetary robotics is an important enabler of scientific exploration in environments where direct human-in-the-loop operation is costly, hazardous, or infeasible. However, developing and validating planetary robotic systems remains difficult because representative field testing is expensive, limited, and often unrepeatable under mission-relevant conditions. In this setting, simulation serves as a central tool for perception and autonomy research, synthetic data generation, system integration, and pre-deployment evaluation. Despite its importance, the literature on planetary robotics simulation remains dispersed across different simulation engines, implementations, and application settings. This paper surveys simulation works for planetary robotic perception and autonomy across four practical axes: Openness and Availability, Scenario and Platform Coverage, Sensor and Perception Support, and Environmental and Operational Realism. The surveyed simulation works report visual or physical fidelity and support perception-oriented workflows. They also indicate uneven public availability, rover-centered coverage, partial support for specialized sensing modalities, and uneven reporting of operational constraints such as onboard computation, energy, and communication restrictions.

摘要（中文）：行星机器人技术在人类直接介入操作成本高昂、存在危险或不可行的情况下，是科学探索的重要推动力量。然而，开发和验证行星机器人系统仍面临诸多挑战，因为在任务相关条件下，代表性实地测试成本高昂、条件受限，且往往无法重复进行。在此背景下，仿真成为感知与自主研究、合成数据生成、系统集成及部署前评估的核心工具。尽管仿真至关重要，但关于行星机器人仿真的文献仍分散于不同的仿真引擎、实现方式及应用场景中。本文从四个实用维度对行星机器人感知与自主性的仿真工作进行了综述：开放性与可用性、场景与平台覆盖、传感器与感知支持，以及环境与运行真实性。所综述的仿真工作报告了视觉或物理保真度，并支持面向感知的工作流程。同时，这些工作也显示出公共可用性不均、以火星车为中心的平台覆盖、对专用传感模态的部分支持，以及在机载计算、能量和通信限制等运行约束方面报告不一致的问题。

Authors: Hoyun Kim, Giseop Kim

ExcavaTwin: Training-Free Geometry-Guided Semantic Elevation Mapping for Autonomous Excavation Other

geometry-guided semantic fusion elevation mapping autonomous excavation multi-view perception frozen vision models

简要说明：ExcavaTwin 提出了一种无需训练、几何引导的语义高程映射框架，用于自主挖掘，利用冻结的视觉模型将多视角 RGB 观测融合为面向任务的空间表示。

TLDR: ExcavaTwin proposes a training-free, geometry-guided semantic elevation mapping framework for autonomous excavation, using frozen vision models to fuse multi-view RGB observations into a task-oriented spatial representation.

Abstract: Autonomous excavation requires a spatial representation that jointly captures terrain geometry and task-relevant semantics. Existing excavation mapping is largely elevation-centric, while generic semantic models remain unstable in unstructured outdoor scenes. We present ExcavaTwin, a pure-vision geometry-guided semantic elevation mapping framework without excavation-specific training. Given multi-view RGB images, the framework: 1) reconstructs scene geometry and semantic observations using frozen vision models; 2) derives terrain and non-terrain geometric support; 3) performs geometry-constrained multi-view semantic fusion to suppress implausible predictions and recover incomplete observations; and 4) projects the fused state into a task-oriented semantic elevation map. Experiments on public datasets and real excavation scenes demonstrate reliable geometric and semantic perception. In real excavation, the system achieved an average update interval of approximately 1.4 s and a mean elevation error of 12.74cm in dynamically modified regions. Larger errors mainly occur during rapid terrain changes and transient visual disturbances caused by machine motion.

摘要（中文）：自主挖掘任务需要一种空间表征，能够同时捕捉地形几何信息与任务相关的语义信息。现有的挖掘建图方法大多以高程为核心，而通用语义模型在非结构化的室外场景中往往稳定性不足。我们提出了ExcavaTwin，一种无需挖掘专用训练的纯视觉几何引导语义高程建图框架。该框架基于多视角RGB图像：1）利用冻结视觉模型重建场景几何并生成语义观测；2）提取地形与非地形的几何支撑信息；3）执行几何约束的多视角语义融合，以抑制不合理预测并补全不完整观测；4）将融合后的状态投影为面向任务的语义高程图。在公开数据集和真实挖掘场景上的实验表明，该系统能够实现可靠的几何与语义感知。在实际挖掘过程中，系统在动态变化区域的平均更新间隔约为1.4秒，平均高程误差为12.74厘米。较大误差主要出现在地形快速变化以及机械运动引起的瞬时视觉干扰期间。

Authors: Yu Deng, Lingshan Zeng, Tong Hu, Rushi Dai

MarsLab: A Martian Rover Simulator for Planetary Rover Autonomous Navigation Other

Martian rover simulator ROS2 autonomous navigation SLAM Visual Place Recognition

简要说明：MarsLab 是一个基于 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 的开源、ROS2 原生火星车模拟器，提供可定制的地形、光照和尘埃条件及传感器数据输出，并展示了 SLAM 和 VPR 基准测试。

TLDR: MarsLab is an open-source, ROS2-native Martian rover simulator built on NVIDIA Isaac Sim, providing customizable terrain, lighting, and dust conditions with sensor data output, and demonstrates SLAM and VPR benchmarks.

Abstract: Future Mars missions will require rover autonomy that can operate across unstructured terrain, changing illumination, atmospheric dust, and limited communication. Simulation is a practical way to study these conditions before deployment, but existing Mars-relevant resources differ in scope, including mission-oriented simulators, fixed analog datasets, task-specific environments, and open robotics interfaces. In this context, we present MarsLab, an open-source, ROS2-native Mars rover simulator for autonomy and navigation algorithm development. MarsLab combines HiRISE-derived and procedural terrain with customizable rock, crater, solar-illumination, and atmospheric-dust settings, and runs a Perseverance-class rover model in NVIDIA Isaac Sim. The runtime publishes RGB, depth, RGB-D point clouds, LiDAR, IMU, wheel odometry, and Ground Truth (GT) pose data through standard ROS2 topics. We demonstrate MarsLab with Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) benchmarks across sensing modalities, dust levels, scene geometry, and route length, and with Visual Place Recognition (VPR) benchmarks over repeated Mars Base traversals under illumination and dust changes. The results illustrate how controlled scene variation and shared GT trajectories can be used to compare trajectory-level estimation and image-level place recognition within the same simulator. Our Project Page: https://kimhoyun-robotair.github.io/MarsLab/.

摘要（中文）：未来的火星任务将要求火星车具备自主性，能够在非结构化地形、变化的光照条件、大气尘埃以及有限通信环境下运行。仿真是在部署前研究这些条件的实用途径，但现有的火星相关资源在范围上存在差异，包括面向任务的仿真器、固定模拟数据集、特定任务环境以及开放的机器人接口。在此背景下，我们提出了MarsLab——一个开源、基于ROS2原生的火星车仿真器，用于自主性与导航算法开发。MarsLab结合了源自HiRISE的地形与程序化生成的地形，并提供可定制的岩石、陨石坑、太阳光照及大气尘埃设置，并在NVIDIA Isaac Sim中运行一款“毅力号”级别的火星车模型。运行时会通过标准ROS2话题发布RGB图像、深度图像、RGB-D点云、激光雷达、惯性测量单元（IMU）、轮式里程计以及真实位姿（GT）数据。我们使用同时定位与建图（SLAM）基准测试对MarsLab进行了验证，覆盖不同感知模态、尘埃水平、场景几何及路线长度；同时，在重复火星基地遍历中，针对光照和尘埃变化，进行了视觉位置识别（VPR）基准测试。结果表明，受控场景变化和共享的真实轨迹可用于在同一仿真器内比较轨迹级估计与图像级位置识别。我们的项目页面：https://kimhoyun-robotair.github.io/MarsLab/。

Authors: Hoyun Kim, Beomsu Kim, Giseop Kim

Sufficiency of Zeroth-Order Reward Shaping for Policy Gradient in Stabilization Control Other

reward shaping policy gradient stabilization control zeroth-order rewards robotic RL

简要说明：本文从理论和实验上分析了策略梯度方法在镇定控制中的奖励塑形，表明零阶（构型）奖励项是充分且必要的，而一阶（速度）奖励项会引入敏感性且并非必需。

TLDR: This paper theoretically and empirically analyzes reward shaping for policy gradient methods in stabilization control, showing that zeroth-order (configuration) reward terms are sufficient and necessary, while first-order (velocity) rewards introduce sensitivity and are not required.

Abstract: Reward shaping is fundamental to modern robotic control with deep reinforcement learning (RL), yet practitioners still rely heavily on heuristic principles borrowed from classical optimal control and trajectory optimization. Existing methods rarely distinguish reward terms that are intrinsic to the control objective from numerical regularizers, leading to brittle hyperparameter tuning. To determine which quantities a reward must contain, we study the stabilization control problem with a focus on zeroth-order (configuration) and first-order (velocity) information. We theoretically and empirically demonstrate that policy gradient methods can successfully solve stabilization tasks without first-order reward terms, adding such terms can instead introduce severe sensitivity as their scale grows. Conversely, our findings confirm that reward functions must be zeroth-order complete over goal-relevant coordinates, while the first-order state remains necessary in the policy observation under our low-dissipation assumptions. Overall, these results provide actionable and principled guidance for reward design in robotic RL.

摘要（中文）：奖励塑形对于基于深度强化学习的现代机器人控制至关重要，然而实践者仍严重依赖从经典最优控制和轨迹优化中借鉴而来的启发式原则。现有方法很少区分与控制目标内在相关的奖励项与数值正则化项，导致超参数调优极为脆弱。为确定奖励必须包含哪些量，我们聚焦于镇定控制问题，并特别关注零阶（构型）信息与一阶（速度）信息。我们从理论和实验两方面证明，策略梯度方法可以在不含一阶奖励项的情况下成功解决镇定任务，而添加此类项反而会随着其量级增大引入严重的敏感性。相反，我们的研究结果证实，奖励函数必须在与目标相关的坐标上具备零阶完备性，同时，在低耗散假设下，策略观测中仍需保留一阶状态信息。总体而言，这些结果为机器人强化学习中的奖励设计提供了可操作且具有原理性的指导。

Authors: Yisheng Zhang, Tao Wang, Sicun Gao

MonoEgo: Monocular Metric Egocentric Demonstration Capture with Passive Wrist Constellations and Sparse Workstation Anchors Other

monocular reconstruction passive wrist constellation metric demonstration capture SLAM egocentric

简要说明：本文提出MonoEgo，一种利用单目重建与被动腕部标记及稀疏工作站锚点来生成图像对齐的度量自我中心演示的采集系统，降低了具身AI数据采集的硬件要求。

TLDR: This paper presents MonoEgo, a capture system that uses monocular reconstruction with passive wrist markers and sparse workstation anchors to create image-aligned metric ego-centric demonstrations, reducing hardware requirements for data collection in embodied AI.

Abstract: Image-aligned metric demonstrations often require dedicated tracking hardware and synchronization across devices. We present MonoEgo, a capture system that replaces active wrist instrumentation with offline monocular reconstruction. One 90-FPS global-shutter camera observes calibrated passive wrist constellations, sparse workstation anchors, and the scene on a shared image clock. MonoTag SLAM combines marker corners with ORB geometry and uses visual evidence to reject ambiguous planar-marker poses. Its metric Atlas supports interval scale re-anchoring, verified map merging, and retrospective localization of earlier frames supported by the final map. Camera and wrist-constellation outputs retain validity and map provenance, and unsupported motion is left missing. Experiments show metric tracking beyond continuous anchor visibility, reconnection of supported map components, and recovery of some missing camera poses. Comparisons against a multisensor camera reference and separate stationary-constellation tests characterize trajectory agreement and precision while revealing incomplete coverage and residual geometric uncertainty. The results indicate that passive fixtures and offline reconstruction can reduce capture-side requirements. Dynamic accuracy, deployment, and downstream policy benefits require further study.

摘要（中文）：图像对齐的度量演示通常需要专用的追踪硬件和多设备之间的同步。我们提出了MonoEgo，一种采集系统，它用离线的单目重建替代了主动式腕部仪器。一个90帧每秒的全局快门相机在统一的图像时钟下，同时观测经过标定的被动腕部标记星座、稀疏工作站锚点以及场景。MonoTag SLAM将标记角点与ORB几何特征相结合，并利用视觉证据来排除模糊的平面标记位姿。其度量Atlas支持区间尺度的重新锚定、验证后的地图合并，以及基于最终地图对早期帧的事后定位。相机和腕部星座的输出保持有效性和地图来源信息，不支持的运动则被保留为缺失状态。实验表明，该方法能够在超过连续锚点可见范围的情况下进行度量追踪，重连支持的地图组件，并恢复部分缺失的相机位姿。与多传感器相机参考系统及独立的静态星座测试的对比，刻画了轨迹一致性和精度，同时也揭示了覆盖不完整和残余几何不确定性问题。结果表明，被动固定装置和离线重建能够降低采集端的要求。动态精度、部署可行性及下游策略收益仍需进一步研究。

Authors: Jie Xu, Kangjin Yu, Ziyi Jin, Beichen Wang, Zhongpu Xia

Robot-Assisted Deployment and Maintenance of Inflatable Modules for Lunar Habitation: A Field Demonstration Other

robot-assisted deployment inflatable modules modular reconfigurable robot lunar habitation field demonstration

简要说明：本文展示了使用模块化可重构机器人在月球栖息地充气模块的部署与维护中的辅助任务，包括检查、对齐、锁定和三维建图，并在实验室和月球模拟场地验证。

TLDR: This paper demonstrates robot-assisted deployment and maintenance of inflatable lunar habitat modules using a modular reconfigurable robot, covering inspection, alignment, locking, and 3D mapping, validated in lab and lunar analogue environments.

Abstract: Long-term human habitation and in-situ development on the Moon open a new era of space utilization. In this context, robots are a key technology for facilitating the construction of future human outposts. Toward the deployment and establishment of human habitation modules on the lunar surface, we propose a combined system consisting of inflatable modules and a modular, reconfigurable robotic system. This paper presents a report demonstrating various robot-assisted task executions using real hardware, namely the modular and reconfigurable robot MoonBot and the inflatable module HIDAS, to enhance the reliability of their deployment and maintenance. The demonstrated tasks include robotic inspection during inflation, module position alignment, final safety locking, and three-dimensional mapping for post-deployment maintenance. All demonstrations were conducted either in a laboratory environment or at a lunar analogue test site. Finally, lessons learned are discussed to provide essential insights for this robotic application to future lunar habitation.

摘要（中文）：长期的人类月球居住与原位开发开启了太空利用的新纪元。在此背景下，机器人在未来人类前哨站的建设中扮演着关键技术角色。为实现月球表面人类居住模块的部署与建立，我们提出了一种由充气模块与模块化、可重构机器人系统组成的联合方案。本文通过实际硬件——即模块化可重构机器人MoonBot与充气模块HIDAS——展示了多种机器人辅助任务执行的结果，以提高其部署与维护的可靠性。所展示的任务包括：充气过程中的机器人检查、模块位置对准、最终安全锁定以及部署后维护所需的三维测绘。所有演示均在实验室环境或月球模拟测试场地完成。最后，总结了实践经验教训，为未来月球居住中的机器人应用提供了重要参考。

Authors: Kentaro Uno, Shamistan Karimov, Ashutosh Mishra, Elian Neppel, Hazal Gozbasi, Shreya Santra, Shinichi Kimura, Kazuya Yoshida

Trajectory-Safe Orienteering for Human-Robot Shared Environments Manipulation

orienteering problem human-robot shared environments collision-free trajectory task planning optimization

简要说明：本文提出了DeCoST，一种两阶段优化方法，用于人机共享空间中的带时间窗和可变利润的定向越野问题，在保证任务质量的同时确保无碰撞轨迹。

TLDR: This paper introduces DeCoST, a two-stage optimization approach for the Orienteering Problem with time windows and variable profits in human-robot shared workspaces, ensuring collision-free trajectories while maintaining task quality.

Abstract: Orienteering problem (OP) has wide real-world applications and also great potential in human-robot collaboration. However, existing approaches struggle to simultaneously ensure safe and feasible trajectories while achieving high-quality task execution in shared workspaces. To this end, this work studies the OP with time windows and variable profits (OPTWVP). A two-stage DEcoupled discrete-Continuous Optimization with Service-time-guided Trajectory (DeCoST) approach is proposed to effectively solve OPTWVP in shared spaces. Meanwhile, the safety-aware time windows of nodes and the discretized workspace are introduced to ensure collision-free trajectories between the end effector and the human. Preliminary results validate the effectiveness of DeCoST in generating collision-free trajectory plans while preserving the quality of orienteering tasks.

摘要（中文）：定向运动问题（OP）在实际应用中具有广泛价值，并在人机协作领域展现出巨大潜力。然而，现有方法在共享工作空间中，难以同时保证轨迹的安全性与可行性，并实现高质量的任务执行。为此，本研究探讨了带时间窗和可变收益的定向运动问题（OPTWVP），提出了一种两阶段解耦离散-连续优化方法，结合服务时间引导轨迹规划（DeCoST），以有效解决共享空间中的OPTWVP。同时，引入节点安全感知时间窗和离散化工作空间，以确保末端执行器与人类之间的无碰撞轨迹。初步结果验证了DeCoST在生成无碰撞轨迹规划的同时，保持定向任务质量的有效性。

Authors: Songqun Gao, Elena Basei, Marco Roveri, Luigi Palopoli, Daniele Fontanelli

3D Point Tracking with State Space Models Perception3D

3D point tracking state space model monocular depth optical flow metric accuracy

简要说明：本文提出了一种3D点跟踪器，结合冻结的光流和单目深度网络与Mamba状态空间模型来细化深度，在单GPU上实现高度量精度，适用于机器人导航和自动驾驶。

TLDR: This paper introduces a 3D point tracker that combines frozen optical flow and monocular depth networks with a Mamba state space model to refine depth, achieving high metric accuracy on a single GPU for applications like robot navigation and autonomous driving.

Abstract: Tracking any point of a dynamic scene in metric 3D - in absolute meters, not up to an unknown scale - underpins 3D and 4D reconstruction, robot navigation, and autonomous driving, where decisions are made in meters, not pixels. Our objective is a 3D point tracker accurate in those absolute terms and operating within a single commodity GPU, pose-free, monocular budget. Our method rests on one observation: once a point's 2D image trajectory is fixed, the quantity that governs its metric accuracy is the depth along its pixel ray. Rather than learning tracking end-to-end, we therefore compose two frozen front-ends - dense optical flow for 2D correspondence and a monocular metric-depth network for the third dimension - and learn only the residual they cannot supply: that depth, refined by a compact state space model (Mamba-3) conditioned on appearance features (DINOv3). A state space model rather than the transformers the strongest 3D trackers adopt is what makes a single-GPU budget attainable: it summarises a track in a fixed-size recurrent state whose memory cost is constant in the number of frames, whereas attention requires a key-value cache that grows linearly with them. On the TAPVid-3D minival benchmark our best configuration attains the highest absolute metric accuracy among methods evaluated under identical conditions (mean metric Average Jaccard, 0.256), exceeding strong feed-forward trackers, while a companion analysis, reproduced with each competitor's own evaluator, explains why several published trackers lose most of their accuracy under this budget.

摘要（中文）：摘要：在度量三维空间（以绝对米为单位，而非未知尺度）中跟踪动态场景的任意点，是三维与四维重建、机器人导航及自动驾驶的基础，这些应用中的决策基于米而非像素。我们的目标是实现一种三维点跟踪器，在绝对度量意义上具有高精度，并且能够在单块商用GPU上、无姿态信息、单目预算条件下运行。我们的方法基于一个观察：一旦点的二维图像轨迹确定，决定其度量精度的量便是沿其像素射线的深度。因此，我们并非端到端地学习跟踪，而是组合两个冻结的前端——用于二维对应的稠密光流和用于第三维的单目度量深度网络——仅学习它们无法提供的残差：即由紧凑状态空间模型（Mamba-3）以外观特征（DINOv3）为条件进行精化的深度。采用状态空间模型而非最强三维跟踪器所用的Transformer，正是使单GPU预算成为可能的关键：状态空间模型以固定大小的循环状态概括轨迹，其内存成本不随帧数变化，而注意力机制则需要随帧数线性增长的键值缓存。在TAPVid-3D minival基准上，我们最优配置在相同条件下评估的方法中取得了最高的绝对度量精度（平均度量Jaccard指数为0.256），超越了强大的前馈跟踪器；同时，一项配套分析（使用各竞争方法自身的评估器复现）解释了为何若干已发表的跟踪器在此预算下会损失大部分精度。

Authors: Masahiro Ogawa, Qi An, Atsushi Yamashita

DeltaSeek: Toward Active Perception in Evolving Construction Environments RLRobot

active perception sensing embodiment permissible observation set construction environment RGB-D

简要说明：DeltaSeek 形式化了机器人的感知具身如何约束在动态建筑环境中的观测，并通过 Husky+UR5e 实验证明腕装相机能观测到底盘相机无法观测的变化。

TLDR: DeltaSeek formalizes how a robot's sensing embodiment constrains observations for active perception in evolving construction environments, demonstrating with a Husky+UR5e that a wrist-mounted camera can observe changes that are impossible from the chassis.

Abstract: Construction environments evolve continuously, causing large geometric changes that degrade static mapping and registration performance. This necessitates active perception, where robots deliberately select sensing configurations to resolve the environment's current state. We present DeltaSeek, an initial framework toward active perception in evolving built environments. While our broader objective is a system that reasons about where, how, and when to observe, this paper addresses a critical prerequisite: how a robot's sensing embodiment constrains the observations it can acquire. We formalize an embodiment's permissible observation set and evaluate with a Husky A300 equipped with a UR5e on an IFC-derived benchmark under chassis-mounted and wrist-mounted RGB-D configurations, scoring observations by geometric visibility and effort by drivable distance. In a room-scale scene with eight controlled changes spanning four observability conditions, exhaustive evaluation over 240 permissible base poses and five arm postures shows that two changes admit no chassis viewpoint whatsoever, while the wrist camera resolves both. For changes observed by both embodiments, the median base travel is $6.0$~m for the wrist camera and $15.2$~m for the chassis camera. These results distinguish sensing limitations from acquisition costs, clarifying whether an observation is impossible or simply requires more travel.

摘要（中文）：建筑环境不断演变，导致大幅几何变化，进而降低静态地图构建与配准的性能。这要求机器人具备主动感知能力，即有意识地选择传感配置以解析环境的当前状态。我们提出了DeltaSeek，一个面向演变建筑环境中主动感知的初步框架。尽管我们的长远目标是构建一个能够推理在何处、如何以及何时进行观察的系统，本文聚焦于一个关键前提：机器人的传感具身如何约束其可获取的观测。我们将具身的可行观测集合形式化，并在基于IFC的基准上，以搭载UR5e的Husky A300平台，在底盘安装与腕部安装两种RGB-D配置下进行评估，分别以几何可见性评分观测，以可行驶距离评估代价。在一个包含八项受控变化、涵盖四种可观测条件的房间尺度场景中，对240个可行基座位姿及五种手臂姿态的穷举评估显示，其中两项变化在任何底盘视角下均不可观测，而腕部相机则可同时解决这两项问题。对于两种具身均能观测的变化，腕部相机的中位基座行程为$6.0$米，而底盘相机为$15.2$米。这些结果将传感限制与获取成本区分开来，厘清了观测究竟是本质上不可能，抑或仅需更多行程即可实现。

Authors: Sanjay Acharjee, Md Nazmus Sakib

Precise Editing and Flexible Referencing for Interactable Worlds WorldModel

video world model world editing gated causal attention sparse context streaming generation

简要说明：EditWorld 是一个视频世界模型，通过在自回归生成过程中引入门控因果注意力和稀疏上下文机制，实现了对交互世界内容的精确编辑与灵活引用，并在相关基准上取得了最优性能。

TLDR: EditWorld is a video world model that enables precise world editing and flexible referencing during autoregressive generation, using gated causal attention, sparse context, and a dedicated training pipeline to outperform existing methods on streaming world editing benchmarks.

Abstract: We present EditWorld, a video world model for precise editing and flexible referencing in interactable worlds. Existing video world models primarily focus on navigation, letting users explore generated worlds but offering limited control over how existing world content is modified. EditWorld extends world modeling from exploration to precise modification by streaming editing instructions and reference images during autoregressive generation. To support these capabilities, EditWorld introduces Gated Causal Attention for temporally varying editing conditions and reference images, together with a Sparse Context mechanism that maintains a bounded historical context for long-horizon inference. We further adopt joint autoregressive and bidirectional training with annealed self-resampling, and construct a dedicated data synthesis and annotation pipeline that provides supervision for world editing. We also present WBench-Editing to systematically evaluate streaming world editing capabilities. EditWorld achieves the best overall performance on WBench-Editing with an overall score of 73.8 and an editing score of 80.0, substantially outperforming existing methods on editing-related metrics. https://github.com/leoisufa/EditWorld

摘要（中文）：我们提出了EditWorld，一种用于可交互世界中精确编辑和灵活引用的视频世界模型。现有视频世界模型主要聚焦于导航，使用户能够探索生成的世界，但对现有世界内容如何被修改的控制能力有限。EditWorld通过自回归生成过程中流式输入编辑指令和参考图像，将世界建模从探索扩展至精确修改。为支持这些能力，EditWorld引入了门控因果注意力机制，以处理随时间变化的编辑条件和参考图像，并采用稀疏上下文机制来维持有界的历史上下文，从而实现长时程推理。我们进一步采用了联合自回归与双向训练，结合退火自重采样策略，并构建了专门的数据合成与标注流程，为世界编辑提供监督。我们还提出了WBench-Editing，以系统评估流式世界编辑能力。EditWorld在WBench-Editing上取得了总体最优性能，综合得分为73.8，编辑得分为80.0，在编辑相关指标上大幅超越现有方法。https://github.com/leoisufa/EditWorld

Authors: Xinyao Liao, Xianfang Zeng, Zhu Liang, Zhoujie Fu, Qianxun Xu, Jiachi Liu, Gang Yu, Guosheng Lin

Do World Models Learn Global Understanding? WorldModel

world models compositional training constraint propagation generalization monoid worlds

简要说明：本文通过构造幺半群世界任务，形式化研究了世界模型是否学习全局理解，发现组合训练能显著改善约束传播和泛化，对具身环境和语言模型有启示。

TLDR: The paper formally studies whether world models learn global understanding by learning constraints from local transitions, finding that compositional training significantly improves generalization and constraint propagation across architectures, with implications for embodied environments and LLMs.

Abstract: AI systems often feel brittle and fragmented. A large language model (LLM) may correctly explain a concept but fail to apply it, or follow safety instructions in one context but not another. This behavior suggests a general failure to lift local information to a global understanding. To gain fundamental insight, we frame "understanding" as learning constraints and propagating their consequences. We construct learning tasks on monoid worlds, sets of states connected by action transitions, where observed training transitions and an unseen constraint jointly determine held-out transitions. Measuring generalization tests whether models can learn global constraints from local transitions and propagate their consequences. We consider inverse, commutativity, composition, and periodicity constraints relevant to spatial and semantic structure. Across attention, recurrent, and state-space architectures, next-state training fits the data but fails to propagate non-trivial constraints. Compositional training, which uses identical paths but hides intermediate states from the input, achieves 96% accuracy on inverse, commutativity, and composition constraints across architectures, yields corresponding improvements in geometric generalization of world models trained on embodied environments and relational generalization in Wikidata-finetuned LLMs. How far do models propagate constraints when inferring an unseen fact may depend on first inferring others? We define proof depth d of a held-out transition, measuring the minimum number of inference rounds to infer the transition, and find that model generalization decreases sharply with proof depth. Increasing compositional path length T improves generalization. These results provide a formal way to investigate global understanding in language and world models and demonstrate that compositional training promotes information propagation and integration.

摘要（中文）：摘要：人工智能系统往往显得脆弱且碎片化。一个大型语言模型可能正确解释某个概念，却无法应用它，或者在某些情境下遵循安全指令而在另一些情境下则不然。这种行为表明，模型在将局部信息提升为全局理解方面存在普遍不足。为了获得根本性洞察，我们将“理解”定义为学习约束并传播其后果。我们在幺半群世界（由动作转换连接的状态集合）上构建学习任务，其中观察到的训练转换与一个未见的约束共同决定保留的转换。通过测量泛化能力，我们检验模型能否从局部转换中学习全局约束并传播其后果。我们考虑了与空间和语义结构相关的逆、交换、合成及周期性约束。在注意力、循环和状态空间架构中，下一状态训练虽能拟合数据，却无法传播非平凡约束。组合训练采用相同路径但隐藏输入中的中间状态，在各类架构上对逆、交换和合成约束实现了96%的准确率，并在具身环境训练的世界模型几何泛化及维基数据微调的LLM关系泛化中带来相应提升。当推断一个未见事实可能依赖于先推断其他事实时，模型能在多大程度上传播约束？我们定义了保留转换的证明深度d，衡量推断该转换所需的最小推理轮数，并发现模型泛化能力随证明深度增加而急剧下降。增加组合路径长度T可改善泛化效果。这些结果为研究语言和世界模型中的全局理解提供了形式化方法，并表明组合训练促进了信息传播与整合。

Authors: Alexander Detkov, Matt Thomson

DynaTokens: Teaching Dynamics to Camera-Controlled Video Models at Test Time WorldModel

video generation camera-controlled world model test-time adaptation DynaTokens dynamic scene generation

简要说明：DynaTokens 引入了一组轻量级的、场景特定的可学习令牌，在测试时向相机控制的视频世界模型传授动态信息，从而在动态场景中更好地同时控制相机运动和物体动态。

TLDR: DynaTokens introduces a lightweight set of learnable scene-specific tokens that teach dynamics to camera-controlled video world models at test time, enabling better simultaneous control of camera motion and object dynamics in dynamic scenes.

Abstract: Video generation must account for two sources of motion, one induced by the observer's camera path and the other caused by scene dynamics. An ideal camera-controlled video model should account for both motions: let users move the camera while evolving the scene dynamics. While current models handle camera-induced motion well in static settings, they struggle for dynamic scenes: objects are static, move incorrectly, or degrade in generation quality. We introduce DynaTokens, a lightweight set of learnable scene-specific tokens that teach dynamics to an existing camera-controlled world model. Our method is motivated by a simple asymmetry between the two sources of motion: whereas camera motion affects the generated view globally, object dynamics are spatially localized. Through cross-attention, DynaTokens trains the learnable tokens from a few example trajectories for a scene while keeping the base model frozen, and enables dynamics under new query camera paths. DynaTokens achieves a better simultaneous dynamics-camera tradeoff on VBench2 and WorldScore evaluations than LoRA, block finetuning, and specialized trainable-layer baselines. Analyses of token attention, ablations, and motion temporality suggest that matching the trainable interface to the structure of the learning target is important for effective adaptation. Project website: https://glab-caltech.github.io/dynatokens/

摘要（中文）：视频生成必须考虑两种运动来源：一种是观察者相机路径引起的运动，另一种是场景动态导致的运动。理想的相机控制视频模型应同时兼顾这两种运动：在场景动态演变的同时，允许用户移动相机。尽管当前模型在静态场景中能较好地处理相机引起的运动，但在动态场景中仍面临挑战：物体要么保持静止、要么运动不正确，要么生成质量下降。我们提出了DynaTokens，这是一组轻量级、可学习的场景特定令牌，用于向现有的相机控制世界模型教授动态信息。我们的方法源于两种运动来源之间一个简单的非对称性：相机运动全局性地影响生成视图，而物体动态则是空间局部化的。通过交叉注意力机制，DynaTokens在保持基础模型冻结的情况下，仅从场景的少量示例轨迹中训练可学习令牌，并能在新的查询相机路径下实现动态生成。在VBench2和WorldScore评估中，DynaTokens在动态与相机控制的同步权衡上优于LoRA、块微调和专用可训练层基线方法。对令牌注意力、消融实验和运动时间性的分析表明，将可训练接口与学习目标的结构相匹配对于有效适配至关重要。项目网站：https://glab-caltech.github.io/dynatokens/

Authors: Ziqi Ma, Hongqiao Chen, Georgia Gkioxari

Proxy2World: Learning to Generate Worlds From Lightweight Proxies without Seeing Them WorldModel

controllable world model depth-conditioned RGB generation joint RGBD generation cross-modal flow matching proxy-camera hybrid denoising

简要说明：Proxy2World 提出了一种可控世界模型，从带位姿的 RGBD 视频中联合学习深度条件 RGB 生成和联合 RGBD 生成，通过代理-相机混合去噪在推理时生成既符合结构又自然美观的视频，无需成对训练数据。

TLDR: Proxy2World proposes a controllable world model that learns depth-conditioned RGB generation and joint RGBD generation from posed RGBD videos, enabling proxy-camera hybrid denoising for structure-adherent, natural-looking video generation from lightweight scene proxies without paired training data.

Abstract: Lightweight scene proxies let creators control scene layout and motion while leaving room for imagination in appearance, lighting, and visual effects. However, a suitable proxy is not uniquely defined, making paired proxy-video data difficult to construct automatically at scale. We present Proxy2World, a controllable world model that learns these complementary capabilities from ordinary posed RGBD videos, without training on authored proxy-video pairs. The model jointly learns depth-conditioned RGB generation and joint RGBD generation through cross-modal flow matching. Learning both tasks enables proxy-camera hybrid denoising at inference to follow the proxy structure while producing natural, detailed visuals. We further introduce ProxyBench to evaluate this capability across a diverse set of scenes, camera trajectories, and subject motions. Experiments on ProxyBench show that Proxy2World achieves a better balance between structural adherence and visual quality than camera-controlled and geometry-conditioned methods, supported by quantitative metrics, VLM assessments, human evaluations and diverse qualitative results.

摘要（中文）：轻量级场景代理使创作者能够控制场景布局与运动，同时为外观、光照和视觉效果保留想象空间。然而，合适的代理并非唯一确定，这使得在规模化条件下自动构建成对的代理-视频数据变得困难。我们提出Proxy2World，一种可控世界模型，它从普通的带位姿RGBD视频中学习这些互补能力，而无需在作者标注的代理-视频对上训练。该模型通过跨模态流匹配，联合学习深度条件下的RGB生成和联合RGBD生成。同时学习这两个任务使得推理时的代理-相机混合去噪能够遵循代理结构，同时生成自然、细节丰富的视觉效果。我们进一步引入ProxyBench，以在多样化的场景、相机轨迹和主体运动集合上评估这一能力。在ProxyBench上的实验表明，Proxy2World在结构遵循和视觉质量之间实现了比相机控制和几何条件方法更好的平衡，这一结论得到了定量指标、VLM评估、人类评价以及多样化定性结果的支持。

Authors: Hongli Xu, Weilong Yan, Anbang Wang, Chunyu Zou, Siyu Hong, Jingwei Huang

CAST: Reconstruction-Coupled Acceleration of Interactive World Models WorldModel

interactive world models reconstruction-coupled inference phase-aware reconstruction KV routing real-time control

简要说明：CAST通过相位感知重建和历史KV路由加速交互式世界模型，在保持视觉质量和交互响应性的同时实现2.15倍至3.48倍的加速。

TLDR: CAST accelerates interactive world models by reconstructing skipped features with phase-aware reconstruction and historical KV routing, achieving 2.15x-3.48x speedups while maintaining visual quality and interactive responsiveness.

Abstract: Interactive world models must respond quickly to controls while preserving scene consistency. Existing acceleration methods can miss heterogeneous control responses and spatial transport when recovering skipped features. We observe that interaction-induced feature changes correlate with approximation error, while low-frequency interpolation errors are phase-sensitive and show more predictable phase progression. These findings motivate CAST, a reconstruction-coupled inference framework. CAST selects anchors by interaction sensitivity and cross-layer coverage, reconstructs skipped residuals with frequency- and confidence-aware Phase-Aware Reconstruction (PAR), and coordinates historical KV routing according to downstream reconstruction responsibility. On Matrix-Game 3.0 and HY-World 1.5, CAST achieves 2.15x and 3.48x speedups, respectively, while maintaining visual quality close to Native (Figure 1). It also attains the highest VBench scores among compared methods and leads non-native baselines on seven and six of thirteen WorldMark dimensions, demonstrating a balance of generation speed, visual quality, and interactive responsiveness under real-time control. Code is available at https://github.com/lokiniuniu/CAST.

摘要（中文）：交互式世界模型必须在保持场景一致性的同时，对控制输入做出快速响应。现有加速方法在恢复跳过的特征时，可能遗漏异构控制响应和空间传输信息。我们观察到，交互引起的特征变化与近似误差相关，而低频插值误差对相位敏感，并表现出更可预测的相位进展。这些发现催生了CAST，一种重建耦合的推理框架。CAST通过交互敏感性和跨层覆盖度选择锚点，利用频率感知和置信度感知的相位感知重建（PAR）恢复跳过的残差，并根据下游重建责任协调历史KV路由。在Matrix-Game 3.0和HY-World 1.5上，CAST分别实现了2.15倍和3.48倍的加速，同时将视觉质量保持在接近原生（Native）的水平（图1）。在对比方法中，CAST还获得了最高的VBench分数，并在WorldMark的13个维度中的七个和六个上领先于非原生基线，展示了在实时控制下生成速度、视觉质量和交互响应性之间的平衡。代码可在https://github.com/lokiniuniu/CAST获取。

Authors: Leyang Chen, Junyi Wu, Fanqing Kong, Shaoqiu Zhang, Yulun Zhang

ViBR-WM: Visual Bayesian Regression for World Modeling WorldModel

Bayesian regression world model visual compression uncertainty quantification temporal forecasting

简要说明：ViBR-WM 通过贝叶斯回归整合视觉特征、物理历史和协变量，预测视觉-物理联合状态，在物体运动、植被和太阳能任务上优于基线。

TLDR: ViBR-WM is a world model that combines visual features, physical histories, and covariates through Bayesian regression to forecast joint visual-physical states, outperforming baselines on object motion, vegetation, and solar power tasks.

Abstract: Modeling temporal dependence and uncertainty is central to forecasting with world models. The Visual Bayesian Regression World Model combines visual features, physical histories and known covariates through interpretable regression, within a modular architecture supporting trend, seasonal and cycle dynamics. Visual compression reduces representation dimension, while Bayesian variable selection reduces active regression dimension. Posterior prediction combines forecasts across predictor subsets using their posterior probabilities as weights and accounts for parameter uncertainty and future disturbances. The model forecasts joint visual--physical states recursively and physical targets directly. Across four forecasting tasks spanning object motion, vegetation greenness and solar power, ViBR-WM achieves lower mean overall physical-target error than Temporal Straightening, ConvLSTM, PredRNN and SimVP on every task. Repeated fitting and resampling support these overall gains.

摘要（中文）：时序依赖与不确定性的建模是采用世界模型进行预测的核心问题。视觉贝叶斯回归世界模型通过可解释的回归结构，将视觉特征、物理历史数据及已知协变量相融合，并采用支持趋势、季节和周期动态的模块化架构。视觉压缩降低了表示维度，而贝叶斯变量选择则缩减了有效回归维度。后验预测在整合各预测子集的预测结果时，以其后验概率作为权重，同时考虑参数不确定性和未来扰动因素。该模型既可递归预测视觉—物理联合状态，也可直接预测物理目标。在涵盖物体运动、植被绿度和太阳能功率的四项预测任务中，ViBR-WM相较于Temporal Straightening、ConvLSTM、PredRNN和SimVP，在每项任务上均实现了更低的平均整体物理目标误差。重复拟合与重采样验证支持了上述整体性能提升。
